We are looking for you to lead the charge in the Agentic Era, building deep specialism in Agent Fabric — the governance and orchestration layer that lets AI act safely and effectively inside the enterprise. You’ll already be hands-on building agents and naturally curious; what matters most is capability in adjacent disciplines such as AI agent orchestration, LLM governance and guardrails, and MCP and A2A, plus the aptitude to build Agent Fabric expertise on the job. MuleSoft’s integration and API backbone gives agents the trusted context and connectivity they need; your job is to turn that foundation into governed, orchestrated, real-world business results.

As a Consumption Value Manager, you own the business outcomes of MuleSoft adoption across your accounts, working in close technical partnership with the customer’s own teams and building enough yourself to speak their language. As a crucial member of the account teams, you’ll use your experience and leading AI tools to build and nurture relationships directly with customers, across Salesforce and the ecosystem. This is a customer-facing role. You will work directly with a set of customers, empowered to manage your portfolio autonomously to achieve the business goals. This role is rooted in stewardship informed by technical fluency; you will be responsible for the adoption and orchestration maturity of MuleSoft solutions including Agent Fabric within our most strategic accounts — building proofs-of-concept and prototypes yourself where they accelerate consumption and value, diagnosing where deeper governance or orchestration gaps sit, and directing the right capability to close them — and for the growth, health and retention that follows from getting that right.

You will act as a business partner to sales leaders, acting as the value and adoption anchor for MuleSoft across their entire territory. You are driving the business and your technical fluency means you can hold your own in a room with architects and enjoy getting hands-on. You bring the information and insights that matter, proactively highlighting where interventions are needed and identifying the customer stories that inspire others. Your goal is to ensure that no customer is left behind and that every organisation recognises the transformative value of their investment in governed, orchestrated AI agents.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Proactive Stewardship: You’ll manage a set of accounts, balancing and prioritising your time to build a range of relationships, gather key insights and deliver business impact
  • Innovation: Your use of Data & AI tools (both existing and ones you’ll create; at Salesforce you have access to the latest tools: Claude, Gemini, Cursor and more) to monitor consumption patterns across your accounts enables you to proactively identify opportunities and mitigate risks. You’ll be with the customer and celebrate new milestones of business outcomes together
  • Show not Tell: You’ll be hands-on with the various products, leading demos and building proof-of-concept projects to demonstrate how to solve new business problems
  • Hands On Depth: Beyond demos, you’ll build real fluency in MuleSoft’s solutions including Agent Fabric — understanding the governance and orchestration detail well enough to guide the conversation and understand when to dig-in versus bringing in the right specialist
  • Value Realisation: Turn technical potential into business outcomes. Your influence and communication skills help stakeholders see the direct line between Data, Integration, Agentic Orchestration and ROI to get buy-in for transformation
  • Business Partnering: Act as a strategic consultant to sales leaders, providing holistic insights into account health and territory trends to ensure sustainable commercial relationships.
  • Lead the Ohana: Work in a highly supportive environment where you help “write the manual” for this new phase of growth, adopting and sharing best practices across a diverse, global team.



You're Our Person If...

  • The Systems Thinker: You have a proven track record (typically 5-7+ years) in customer-facing solutioning or consulting. You understand enterprise IT and how applications and data connect together with APIs providing the context that powers AI. You understand how business processes turn into agentic actions that need orchestration and governance, and you have the technical curiosity to quickly build real fluency in how MuleSoft’s Agent Fabric governance and orchestration model works, even without prior hands-on exposure to it.
  • The Do-er: You bring demonstrated hands-on depth in a related discipline — Agentic technical capabilities such as AI agent orchestration, LLM governance/guardrails or MCP and A2A — with the technical aptitude to ramp quickly into MuleSoft’s Agent Fabric. We’re hiring for transferable technical depth and fast ramp-up.
  • Customer-First: You want to influence outcomes and see them through to fruition. Being given ownership of a territory and the autonomy to drive its success motivates you.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

We are looking for a Director, Executive Talent Experiences to reimagine how we develop, enable, and support our most senior leaders. This is not a traditional learning and development role. It sits at the intersection of executive development, organizational change, executive operations, talent strategy, and AI. The person in this role will design and orchestrate high-impact experiences that help senior leaders change how they lead, make better decisions, and scale their impact across the organization.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
 

Shape the Future of Executive Development

  • Define and evolve the strategy for executive talent experiences across the company, aligned to business strategy and the capabilities required for the next generation of leaders.

  • Design distinctive, high-impact experiences for executives and senior leaders that drive measurable changes in leadership behavior, decision-making, and organizational performance.

  • Translate business priorities, leadership challenges, and organizational shifts into targeted development experiences, interventions, and moments that matter.

  • Reimagine executive development beyond traditional courses and workshops through experiences, simulations, coaching, peer learning, real-work application, and AI-enabled development.

  • Build differentiated experiences for different executive populations, leadership moments, and business contexts.

  • Bring an AI-first approach to learning

  • Serve as a thought leader on the future of executive learning and development in an AI-enabled organization.

  • Explore and apply AI to personalize development journeys, generate insights, create simulations and scenarios, augment coaching, and make learning more continuous and embedded in leaders’ day-to-day work.

  • Experiment rapidly with emerging AI capabilities and translate them into practical, high-quality executive experiences.

  • Design for a world where leaders can learn in the flow of work, leverage AI as a thought partner, and receive highly personalized development support.

  • Establish principles and standards for responsible, high-quality use of AI in executive talent experiences.


Elevate the Executive Experience

  • Operate with a true chief-of-staff mindset: anticipate needs, understand context, connect dots, manage details, and ensure every executive interaction feels intentional and seamless.

  • Partner closely with executives, chiefs of staff, executive assistants, HR business partners, talent leaders, and other senior stakeholders to understand needs and deliver exceptional experiences.

  • Prepare leaders and stakeholders for critical moments such as leadership transitions, strategic shifts, executive offsites, succession discussions, major organizational changes, and executive onboarding.

  • Bring rigor and polish to the end-to-end experience, from design and preparation through delivery, follow-through, and measurement.

  • Build deep trust with senior leaders and become a credible thought partner on leadership and talent

  • Build Executive Talent and Succession synergies

  • Partner with senior HR and business leaders to strengthen executive talent strategy, including succession planning, executive readiness, talent reviews, and leadership pipelines

  • Identify critical capabilities and experiences leaders need to be ready for future roles and increasingly complex business challenges

  • Connect executive development more explicitly to talent decisions, succession, mobility, and organizational capability.

  • Develop mechanisms to identify emerging leadership needs and create targeted development responses before gaps become business problems

  • Use talent and organizational data to surface trends, risks, and opportunities across the executive population.

  • Develop frameworks, operating rhythms, and mechanisms that make executive development more consistent, scalable, and measurable

  • Build systems that connect insights from executive development, talent reviews, succession, organizational changes, and business performance

  • Establish meaningful measures of impact that go beyond participation and satisfaction to assess behavior change, leadership effectiveness, organizational outcomes, and talent movement

  • Use data, qualitative insight, and executive feedback to continuously improve experiences

  • Balance bespoke executive experiences with scalable solutions that can evolve with the organization

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Executives experience development that is relevant, personalized, high-value, and worthy of their time

  • Leadership experiences lead to observable changes in behavior, decision-making, and organizational impact

  • Executive development is tightly connected to business strategy, succession, and the future capabilities of the organization

  • AI is meaningfully embedded into how executives learn, reflect, practice, and grow—not added as a superficial technology layer

  • The organization has better visibility into executive talent, capability gaps, and readiness for future leadership roles

  • The team is known for exceptional judgment, responsiveness, creativity, and white-glove execution

  • Executive talent experiences become a competitive advantage for attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional leaders


PRIMARY THREE SKILL SETS
 

Learning Designer: You know how to create learning experiences that change behavior, not simply transfer knowledge. You understand adult learning, executive development, behavior change, organizational dynamics, and how to design interventions that stick at the senior-most levels.

Chief of Staff: You understand how executives think, make decisions, prioritize, communicate, and operate. You bring exceptional judgment, attention to detail, anticipation, discretion, and a white-glove orientation to every
executive interaction and experience.

Analytical & Systems Thinker: You can see patterns across leaders, teams, talent systems, and business priorities. You use data and insight to diagnose leadership needs, identify systemic opportunities, and build scalable mechanisms rather than one-off programs.

AI-First Mindset: Above all, you will bring an AI-first mindset to executive talent. You will help define what executive development looks like in a world where AI can personalize learning, accelerate insight, simulate leadership situations, augment coaching, and fundamentally change how leaders learn and work.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Significant experience in executive development, leadership development, talent management, organizational effectiveness, learning experience design, chief-of-staff work, strategy, or a related field

  • Demonstrated ability to design learning and development experiences that result in behavior change and organizational impact, particularly with senior or executive populations

  • Strong understanding of executive leadership, organizational dynamics, talent strategy, and the realities of operating at scale

  • Exceptional executive presence and the ability to build trust and credibility with C-suite and senior leaders

  • Strong chief-of-staff instincts: highly organized, detail-oriented, anticipatory, discreet, pragmatic, and excellent at managing complexity

  • Strong analytical and systems-thinking capabilities; able to synthesize ambiguous inputs, identify patterns, and turn insight into action

  • Experience with executive talent processes such as succession planning, talent reviews, leadership assessments, executive onboarding, or executive coaching

  • Curiosity and demonstrated interest in AI and the future of work and learning, with a willingness to experiment and challenge conventional approaches

  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills

  • Ability to operate comfortably between strategy and execution—zooming out to define the system and zooming in to ensure every detail is right

  • you are equally comfortable in three modes: Strategist — You can see around corners, understand the business, and define what leaders will need next; Designer — You can turn a complex leadership challenge into an experience that changes behavior and creates lasting impact; Operator — You execute with extraordinary precision and care, understand how executives operate, and make complex experiences feel effortless.

  • You are intellectually curious, highly discerning, low-ego, and energized by ambiguity; you care deeply about the quality of the experience, but you care even more about whether it actually changes how leaders lead and how organizations perform

About the Role

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

The Builder Experience

  • AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.

  • Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.

  • Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time.  You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures  and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them. 

  • Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

What You'll Actually Be Building

  • Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.

  • Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform  and current LLM techniques.

  • Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.

  • Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output

  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.

  • Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.

  • Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.

  • Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the  product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.

  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist  in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If…

  • You have 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models

  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field

  • You are fluent in English + another EMEA language

  • You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.

  • You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.

  • You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.

  • You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.

  • You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.

  • You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.

  • You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.

  • You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.

  • You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)

  • Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns

  • Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)

Job Title: Senior Product Security Engineer

The Experience

  • Salesforce's Platform Security team protects the platform that our customers, partners, and developers build on. We are hands-on security engineers who work closely with Product and Engineering throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • As a Senior Product Security Engineer, you secure the platform's integration and service-connectivity layer. This includes events, messaging, connectors, Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), and the agent and Model Context Protocol (MCP) connectors that let external tools and AI models talk to the platform.
  • You help a fast-moving Engineering organization ship safely. You do this through threat modeling, design and code reviews, and secure-by-default guidance. You also get to shape how AI agents connect securely to the world's #1 AI CRM.
  • This role is based in San Francisco, CA, or Seattle/Bellevue, WA and is eligible for a hybrid work arrangement.



What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Lead threat modeling and security design reviews for the platform's event, messaging, and integration pathways, connectors, and APIs that move customer data between systems. Trace issues to their root cause so fixes land in the right place.
  • Secure service-to-service authentication, external client apps, and agent and MCP connectors, where excessive privilege, secret leakage, and misuse of delegated access are key threats.
  • Build secure-by-default patterns into frameworks, connector software development kits (SDKs), and onboarding paths. Review Java, JavaScript, and TypeScript code in a large codebase to validate design assumptions and find risk in authentication, integration, and access-control flows.
  • Partner with architects, engineers, and product owners to move findings to resolution, and mentor junior security engineers on secure design and threat modeling.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have 5+ years of experience in product, application, or platform security.
  • You have hands-on experience securing backend, integration, or service-connectivity systems, including API security (REST and GraphQL authentication, rate limiting, and input validation).
  • You have working experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and JSON Web Tokens (JWT), plus service-to-service authentication and permission models.
  • You have reviewed source code in Java and at least one other language (JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or Go) to confirm security risk.



Even Better If...

  • You have secured eventing, messaging, integration, or API platforms at scale.
  • You have connector security, agent integration, or MCP experience, including how trust boundaries work in agentic systems beyond basic prompt injection.
  • You have multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS) backend security experience at the application layer.
  • You have served as the embedded security subject-matter expert (SME) for a product area.
  • You can independently own threat models and explain distributed-systems risks such as race conditions and concurrency flaws.
  • You write clear security guidance and lead design reviews that keep teams moving.

Job Description

Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.

You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.


What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
  • Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
  • Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
  • Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
  • Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
  • Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
  • Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
  • Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
  • Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
  • Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
  • From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
  • Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
  • Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

You're Our Person If...

  • Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
  • 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
  • Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
  • Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
  • Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
  • Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
  • Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
  • Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
  • Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
  • Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
  • Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
  • Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
  • Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
  • Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

  • Positionnement stratégique : Développer des relations clés avec les parties prenantes des comptes assignés et garantir leur satisfaction client.
  • Stratégie de compte : Élaborer et piloter la stratégie globale à long terme pour chaque compte, en phase avec les objectifs commerciaux du client.
  • Leadership d'influence : Diriger le processus de vente de bout en bout en mobilisant les ressources appropriées (ingénieurs avant-vente, services professionnels, cadres dirigeants, partenaires, etc.).
  • Territoire & prospection : Identifier et analyser son territoire afin de formaliser une stratégie de mise sur le marché (go-to-market) et établir une liste de comptes cibles qualifiés sous 30 jours.
  • Développement de réseau : Promouvoir la proposition de valeur de Salesforce auprès des clients actuels et potentiels.
  • Croissance de compte : Stimuler la croissance au sein d'un portefeuille de comptes existants.



You're Our Person If...

  • Leadership & Orchestration : Expérience de la vente auprès de dirigeants « C-suite » et capacité avérée à diriger des équipes transverses et élargies.
  • Compréhension métier : Compréhension des enjeux commerciaux spécifiques aux clients de secteurs variés, et capacité à travailler en équipe pour résoudre des problèmes dans des environnements complexes et dynamiques. Even Better If...

This role is split between overseeing our outsourced management testing operations and building a best-in-class business process Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM) program — with the balance shifting toward continuous monitoring as the roadmap matures.
The ideal candidate pairs deep SOX/internal audit technical fundamentals with a builder's mindset: comfortable evaluating which controls are ripe for automation, partnering with control owners, AI, and tooling teams to implement monitoring solutions, and leveraging data analytics to increase testing precision, reduce reliance on point-in-time sampling, and optimize program spend.

Continuous Monitoring Strategy & Implementation (the growth engine of this role)

  • Design & Implement Solutions: Partner with process owners, engineering, and tooling leads to build continuous monitoring solutions—ranging from exception-based dashboards and automated queries to fully automated control testing.
  • Drive Full-Population Assurance: Champion data analytics to shift the program from periodic sample-based testing toward ongoing full-population monitoring, enabling earlier issue detection and control precision.

Partner collaboratively with vendor leadership to ensure continuous monitoring innovations directly convert into reduced billable testing hours and program cost efficiencies.

You'll join a practice navigating one of the most technically demanding moments in its history: the shift to Agentforce delivery at enterprise scale, in regulated industries, in Spanish.
As an STC, you're the person who gets things built. You'll own technical workstreams end-to-end — from solution design through to go-live — on multi-cloud Salesforce implementations that live inside complex enterprise architectures. This is a hands-on delivery role with real customer impact and a clear path toward Technical Architect.

What You'll Actually Be Doing:


Build & Deliver

  • Design and implement high-quality Salesforce solutions — Apex, LWC, Flow, and integrations — not just review them
  • Lead technical workstreams on complex, multi-cloud implementations including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Agentforce, and Data Cloud
  • Own Proof of Concepts (POCs) end-to-end, from architecture to working demo
  • Produce and maintain key solution artefacts: technical design documents, data models, integration specs

Integrate & Engineer

  • Design and build enterprise integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architectures (Platform Events, Kafka), and middleware platforms (MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, custom)
  • Write clean, maintainable code in multiple languages — Salesforce-native (Apex, LWC) but also Python for data pipelines, scripting, and AI/ML tooling, and JavaScript/Node.js for front-end customisation and headless integrations
  • Work with structured and unstructured data: SQL/SOQL, JSON/XML transformations, ETL processes
  • Understand and navigate the broader enterprise technology stack — ERP, CRM, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) — because Salesforce rarely lives alone

Collaborate & Advise

  • Work alongside Technical Architects to translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions
  • Engage directly with customer technical teams — developers, IT leads, and project owners — as a trusted day-to-day delivery partner

The Experience:

In this highly visible role, the Manager, Revenue Recognition Strategy will lead our Standalone Selling Price (SSP) program, including methodology, periodic analysis, reporting, controls, and audit support. SSP determines how revenue is allocated across the products and services in every bundled deal, so your work directly affects the accuracy of our reported results and how confidently the business can launch new pricing, packaging, and go-to-market initiatives. The role also supports monthly and quarterly processes and shares responsibility for SOX compliance, the integration of acquired entities, and system projects within the Revenue Recognition team. As a subject matter expert in Revenue Recognition, you will support our internal revenue team and business partners in reviewing, guiding, and implementing new go-to-market initiatives. You will thrive in a fast-paced, changing environment and work across many functions, including Finance, Product, Sales, Business Technology (BT), and external vendors. You will also need to understand a wide range of issues and business models driven by acquisitions, revenue recognition requirements, and strategic shifts in go-to-market strategy. The position reports to the Director, Revenue Recognition.

What You'll Actually Be Doing:

  • Lead the end-to-end SSP process, including methodology, periodic refresh, data analysis, calculations, and documentation, and continue to enhance and streamline it as the business evolves
  • Partner with business teams to address technical revenue recognition questions on new deal models, pricing and packaging changes (including bundles and potential material rights), and partnerships, and assess SSP implications before launch
  • Establish and maintain SSP policies and guardrails in partnership with Pricing, Deal Desk, and Sales Operations, and identify gaps in policies and procedures, including SSP, stemming from new go-to-market and sales initiatives
  • Serve as the primary SSP contact for external auditors and SOX testing, owning SSP-related key controls and sharing responsibility for SOX compliance with the Revenue Recognition team and business partners
  • Improve existing processes and identify and deliver automation opportunities that reduce manual analysis and recalculation, working with the Revenue Recognition team and business partners
  • Draft technical accounting memos related to relevant new guidance and/or non-standard transactions and business models
  • Create and deliver presentations to company management and external auditors on highly technical topics
  • Lead the SSP and revenue allocation requirements for IT system projects, including Revenue Management System upgrades, and ensure the pricing and transaction data that feeds SSP is complete and accurate
  • Support the integration of acquired entities by establishing SSP for acquired products and aligning their revenue policies, processes, and controls with company standards

You're Our Person If...

  • 6+ years of progressive accounting experience (Big 4 and/or industry), including 3+ years in technical revenue recognition under ASC 606 in a public company environment
  • Undergraduate degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field.
  • Hands-on experience performing, reviewing, or auditing SSP analyses for multi-element arrangements, including methodology, data analysis, and documentation
  • Strong working knowledge of ASC 606 (including multi-element arrangements, variable consideration, contract modifications, and material rights)
  • Experience researching technical accounting topics and drafting technical accounting memos and policies
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to analyze large transaction datasets (for example, with SQL or similar tools)
  • Proactive, collaborative leader with sharp attention to detail, comfortable operating with significant autonomy, with the rigor to produce audit-ready analysis and SOX-ready documentation.
  • Project management skills, including planning, task assignment, status tracking, and reporting
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate clearly, both verbally and in writing

Even Better If...

  • Experience with Quote-to-Cash systems (e.g., Zuora Revenue, Salesforce and Tableau)
  • CPA (or equivalent professional certification) strongly preferred
  • SaaS and software revenue recognition experience, including subscription, term license, and services bundles
  • Experience applying automation or analytics tools (for example, SQL, Python, or AI-enabled workflows) to improve accounting processes, with appropriate review and controls
  • Ability to quickly grasp company operations and business drivers

  • Communicate proactively with stakeholders about build status, risks, and tradeoffs — especially when live stage demos require explicit escalation to product teams
  • Collaborate with localization teams for multi-language and multi-market demo delivery

Technical Strategy & Innovation

  • Evaluate emerging Salesforce features and recommend which to showcase in upcoming demos
  • Make architectural decisions about build approaches: real product vs. mocked, single-org vs. multi-org, live vs. static
  • Contribute to the team's proof pattern library covering core enterprise scenarios
  • Contribute to the teams enablement and distribution documentation for SE and global events
  • Drive continuous improvement in demo stability, build efficiency, and technical quality
  • Partner with development team members on complex builds

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience building live product demonstrations for large audiences (conferences, keynotes, executive briefings, or webinars)
  • Experience with Slack platform development (Slack apps, Slackbot skills, workspace administration, federation)
  • Knowledge of Tableau integration and data visualization
  • Ability to turn high fidelity designs into functional prototypes using HTML/HTML5, CSS/CSS3, Javascript
  • Experience developing on the Salesforce platform (Aura, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce Administration etc.) - MUST
  • Experience with Salesforce unit testing and package management - MUST
  • Experience developing user interfaces in non-traditional formats such large format screens, car dashboards, AR/VR etc.
  • Strong object orient programming background
  • Familiarity with backend development concepts such as creating servers, REST APIs, and microservices
  • Familiarity with iOS, xCode, and Swift development
  • Experience designing, specifying, integrating, and testing cutting edge hardware with software APIs
  • Collaborate and communicate on multiple, complex projects concurrently, with a team of designers, developers and marketers from concept to completion


What Makes This Role Unique
This is not a typical Software Engineer position. Here's what sets it apart:

  • Breadth: You'll build across the entire Salesforce ecosystem in a single quarter

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

As a Principal AI Architect (or AI and Data Technical Architect), you will act as a senior, hands-on technical leader and trusted advisor to our customers. You will be responsible for designing, validating, and operationalizing enterprise-grade data and AI architectures centered on Salesforce D360 and the Agentforce platform. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, platform architecture, and applied AI, requiring you to guide customer Chief Data Officers and Enterprise Architects through emerging AI solutions. You will work side-by-side with Account Executives and Product teams to ensure customers realize the full value of the platform by designing scalable, secure solutions that integrate D360 into complex enterprise ecosystems—including hyperscalers, data lakes, and governance frameworks.

Responsibilities

  • Lead pre-sales technical design by analyzing customer needs and recommending solutions aligned with Agentforce capabilities and integration with external agent frameworks.
  • Shape best practices around generative AI, agent interoperability, prompt engineering, Data Cloud, and cross-platform integrations.
  • Collaborate with AEs and SEs to build hands-on prototypes and demos using Agentforce and integrated external agents.
  • Develop thought leadership content—demo templates, whitepapers, enablement sessions—focused on agent lifecycle, integration strategy, and technical effectiveness.
  • Act as a central technical knowledge resource, proactively addressing internal technical inquiries, facilitating deep technical enablement, and documenting best practices to empower specialist teams across the organization.
  • If you are naturally curious about AI and Data, love diving into new technologies, and enjoy educating others while crafting solutions that deliver real business impact, we want to talk to you!
  • Understand Agent Interoperability - Map and integrate external agents from hyperscalers (e.g. Copilot, Gemini) into Agentforce via open standards (MCP, A2A); design how these systems collaborate.
  • Enable Conversational & Background Agents - Use Agentforce Studio and Agent Builder to configure chat and background agents; integrate with external channels including voice via hyperscaler APIs.
  • Drive Prompt Engineering & Lifecycle Strategy - Lead prompt design, testing, monitoring, and iteration; define agent lifecycle best practices from development through refinement.
  • Build Hands-On Demos & Prototypes - Co-create quick prototypes (<2 weeks) with AEs demonstrating integration between Agentforce and external agents or services.
  • Lead Pre-Sales Workshops - Facilitate whiteboarding, deep-dive sessions, and quick enablement for customers and internal teams.
  • Advise on Data & Integration - Integrate Data Cloud (D360), CRM, MuleSoft APIs, and external agent endpoints ensuring cohesive architectures that align with compliance and governance policies.
  • Support Early Adoption - Occasionally assist in proof-of-value engagements post-sale by tuning agents and guiding customers toward self-sufficient enablement.
  • Own Technical Architecture Decisions - Oversee data modeling, identity resolution, real-time vs. batch patterns, data graph design, and activation strategies within D360.
  • Own Technical Enablement - Create and manage accessible technical documentation, knowledge bases, and FAQ resources to rapidly resolve internal technical inquiries, empowering specialist teams to handle technical discussions confidently.


Required Qualifications

  • Technical Pre-Sales & Solution Engineering: 7+ years in customer-facing technical pre-sales, solution architecture, or technical advisory, partnering side-by-side with Account Executives (AEs) to drive enterprise deal cycles and business outcomes.
  • Enterprise AI & Hyperscaler Ecosystem Depth: Proven experience designing and delivering AI, GenAI, and Data architectures within platforms such as AWS (Bedrock/SageMaker), Microsoft (Azure AI Foundry/Copilot), Databricks, Google Cloud (Vertex AI), Snowflake, or Palantir.
  • Hands-On Modern AI & Agentic Builder Experience: Direct hands-on experience building, prototyping, or solutioning with frontier LLMs and modern AI tools—including OpenAI, Claude, LangChain / LangGraph, Cursor, or multi-agent orchestration frameworks.
  • Agent Interoperability & Open Standards: Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, background/conversational agents, voice AI integrations, or open protocols (e.g., Model Context Protocol - MCP, A2A).
  • Rapid Prototyping & Whiteboarding: Demonstrated ability to lead technical discovery workshops and co-create rapid proof-of-value prototypes (<2 weeks) for C-suite stakeholders (CDO, CTO, Enterprise Architects).
  • Location: Based in London, UK (hybrid model).

Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have):

    • CRM / Salesforce Context: Prior familiarity or hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM, Agentforce Studio, or Data Cloud (D360).
    • Multi-Modal & Advanced AI Frameworks: Experience with voice pipelines, MLOps, vector search, or custom model fine-tuning.
    • Education: BS/MS in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or equivalent technical field

Start Date: February 2027

We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in Salesforce to apply for the next cohort of our EMEA Graduate Rotation Program - Solution Engineering Path.

This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both solution engineering and sales. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Solution Engineering careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards.

Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned an experienced Solution Engineering Buddy who will provide hands-on coaching and involve you in some of their live deals. Who are we looking for?


  • You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree)
    • For the Solution Engineering Path, we consider applicants from the following academic backgrounds:
      Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Science/Data Engineering, Information Systems, or other Adjacent disciplines.
  • You are a creative problem-solver
  • You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset
  • You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning
  • You thrive in a team environment
  • You have excellent interpersonal skills
  • You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • You are fluent in English + Polish, Czech, OR Croatian is essential

What does our new EMEA Graduate Program look like?


The program is structured as follows:


Introduction Month


During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:

  • Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values
  • Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools
  • Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce
  • Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni

Rotations


During the Graduate Program, you will experience both the Solution Engineering Path and the Sales Path. The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path.

If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in Solution Engineering, you will then join the Sales Graduate Rotation from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. Over these six months, you will gain exposure to both roles. The time spent mastering the fundamentals of these complementary disciplines will enable you to be more productive and impactful upon promotion.

Throughout the rotations, there will be self-paced certifications and skills assessments. You must meet all eligibility criteria before you can panel for promotion.


Examples of what you can expect during the rotations


Solution Engineering Graduate Rotation


  • Learn our solutions at a deeper, more technical level
  • Work closely with the Solution Engineering organisation, supporting the creation of cutting-edge customer demonstrations
  • Learn the art of customer discovery and how to create a compelling customer point of view

Sales Graduate Rotation


  • Learn Salesforce’s best-in-class prospecting and qualification methodologies
  • Learn how to use social, digital, video, chat, and phone platforms to effectively engage Salesforce prospects
  • Collaborate with Sales Development Specialists to run campaigns and help build sales pipeline for the EMEA Sales organisation

What’s in it for you?


  • A clear and structured career path within our Solution Engineering organisation
  • The opportunity to work in an international team within a nurturing environment
  • Access to our diverse internal employee groups
  • A comprehensive benefits package
  • Relocation budget and guidance throughout your relocation process
  • An additional seven days of paid time off for charitable causes – learn more about our 1-1-1 model

Map your future for the coming years


With the EMEA Graduate Program - Solution Engineering Path, you can continue to progress:


  • After completing the Graduate Program rotations, you may progress to Associate Solution Engineer, with opportunities to work across ESB, SMB, and GRB customer segments, or join our Specialist SE team. In some instances, this path may vary or be subject to change.

AI-Native Delivery とは、従来の「人が一つひとつ手作業で構築する」デリバリーから、「AIエージェントが技術成果物（メタデータ・設定・コード・テスト・ドキュメント等）を生成し、人が意図の定義・検証・承認・ガバナンスに注力する」新しいデリバリーモデルへの転換を指します。GDCが世界規模で確立したこのモデルを日本市場に導入・定着させ、日本のデリバリーのあり方そのものを変革することが最大のミッションです。

お客様にとっての Trusted Guide（信頼できるガイド）として、業務の可視化と意図の明確化を起点に、Agentforce をはじめとする Salesforce ソリューションの設計・構築・検証・本番展開・定着化・内製化までを一貫してリードし、お客様のビジネス成果と ROI（投資対効果）を最大化します。

本ポジションの特徴

(1) SPSMをベースにGDC主導のAI-Native Deliveryを自ら主導し、日本のデリバリーを変革する

グローバル標準手法である SPSM を土台に、GDCがグローバルで確立した AI-Native Delivery を、日本のお客様のプロジェクトで自ら主導します。単にグローバルの手法を適用するだけでなく、日本固有のビジネスコンテキストや商習慣に合わせて最適化し、日本の Delivery Method そのものの変革をリードします。GDCの世界水準の技術力・知見と密に連携しながら、日本市場における AI-Native Delivery の推進役を担います。

(2) AI-Nativeプロジェクトのデリバリーを主要な工程で自ら主導する

AIエージェントによる自動化（agentic automation）を、エンドツーエンドのAIプロジェクトデリバリーの主要な工程に適用し、デリバリーのタイムラインを大幅に加速します。要件分析／ユーザーストーリー作成／意思決定の記録／自動ビルド・デプロイ／オブザーバビリティという5つの主要な工程でエージェンティックな自動化を活用し、各工程でAIが生成・実行し人が検証・承認する「AI generates, humans decide（AIが生成し、人が判断する）」を実践します。生成の速さと人による品質統制を両立させ、Trusted Guide として工程全体を主導します。

(3) AI-Native Delivery を軸に、広範な技術領域へ拡大する

技術領域は Agentforce にとどまらず、Data Cloud、Salesforce プラットフォーム全般（Sales / Service / Marketing）、外部AIサービス連携まで広がります。AIツール群を適材適所で活用し、デリバリーのスピードと品質を両立させます。従来型と比べて高い生産性を実現し、短いサイクルでの開発サイクルを推進します。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • AI-Native Delivery の主導と日本市場への定着 GDCがグローバルで確立した AI-Native Delivery と SPSM を、日本のお客様のプロジェクトで自ら主導する。日本固有のビジネスコンテキストに合わせて手法を最適化・適用し、日本の Delivery Method の変革をリードする。
  • AI-Nativeプロジェクトのデリバリー（agentic automationの活用） エンドツーエンドのAIプロジェクトデリバリーを加速するため、以下の主要な工程でAIエージェントによる自動化を活用し、各工程を主導する。要件分析: 複雑なお客様要件の抽出・分析・構造化を高速化し、手作業による認識合わせのループを最小化する。ユーザーストーリー作成: 詳細で着手可能なユーザーストーリーと受入基準を自動生成し、スプリント計画の時間を大幅に短縮する。意思決定の記録: 重要なアーキテクチャ上の決定や設計上の選択を自動的に文書化し、継続的で信頼できる「唯一の情報源（source of truth）」を維持する。自動ビルド・デプロイ: エージェンティックなワークフローにより、コード生成・CI/CDパイプライン・環境構築を効率化する。オブザーバビリティ: 能動的なモニタリングとトレーシングを実装し、エージェントの最適なパフォーマンス・信頼性、およびデプロイ後の迅速なトラブルシューティングを確保する。
  • 品質統制 AIエージェントが生成したメタデータ・設定・コード・テスト・ドキュメントを レビューし、検証し、承認する。生成の速さだけでは価値にならず、人による検証と承認をセットにして初めて成果になるという原則を徹底する。LLMの柔軟性とルールベースの正確性の境界を見極め、ハイブリッドなアプローチで決定論的に制御する。
  • 成果ベースのデモンストレーション ステータス報告資料ではなく、実際に動作するソフトウェア（実画面・実フロー・実データ）でビルドの成果を実証する。
  • GDCとの協働 グローバルのGDCと密に連携し、その世界水準の技術力・知見を活かしながらデリバリーを推進する。お客様と直接対話してスコープを合意し、GDC側へは日本固有のコンテキストを排除した明確で誤解のない指示として伝達する。



You're Our Person If...

  • 実務経験: 5-11年以上のエンタープライズ・システムにおけるコンサルティング、または要件定義から設計・開発・テスト・本番移行に至る構築プロセスの主導的な実務経験。
  • IT構築プロセスの理解: 戦略策定・意図定義から要件定義、設計・開発・テスト・移行に至る一連のプロセスの深い知見。
  • AIリテラシーと実務活用経験: AI・LLMを活用したソリューション構築、またはAIツール群を用いた実務効率化の経験。「推論・確率ベース」と「ルールベース」の双方の基礎理解。
  • 論理的コミュニケーション力: 意図を明確に言語化し、お客様やチームと合意形成できる力。
  • 言語能力:日本語: 流暢（お客様と円滑に合意形成できること）英語: ビジネスレベル（GDCのメンバーと技術的な詳細を議論・指示できること）



Even Better If...

  • 業務分析・モデリング（UML / BPMN / DMN 等）の経験
  • 顧客折衝・合意形成、エンタープライズアーキテクチャの経験
  • API／インテグレーション設計、新技術導入提案・PoC の経験
  • Salesforce プラットフォーム（Apex / Flow / Data Cloud）の開発経験
  • Agentforce をはじめとする対話型AI・エージェント開発（プロンプトエンジニアリング、AIオーケストレーション、エージェントフレームワーク）の経験
  • 異文化環境での協働経験、およびインドGDC等の海外技術者と英語で協働した経験
  • Salesforce 認定資格（Administrator / Platform Developer / Application・System Architect 等）



SPSMをベースにGDC主導のAI-Native Deliveryを自ら主導し、日本のデリバリーの変革を通じてお客様のビジネス成果を支援します。特定の役割に固定されず、AI-Native Delivery の全フェーズを幅広く担当します。

本ポジションで得られる経験グローバル標準手法（SPSM）とAI-Native Deliveryを、自ら主導して日本市場に導入・変革する実務経験AI・データを前提とした最先端デリバリーモデルの専門性意図定義から定着化までを一貫して担う、業務変革の実務経験複数の技術領域を横断する総合的なコンサルティング能力グローバルチーム（GDC）と協働し、グローバル標準手法を日本市場に適用する経験

求める人物像AIを武器にできる方: 従来のやり方に固執せず、AIや新しいテクノロジーを積極的に取り入れ、デリバリーの形そのものを進化させたい方。変革を自ら主導できる方: グローバル標準手法とAI-Native Deliveryを日本市場に導入し、日本のデリバリーのあり方そのものを変えていく当事者意識を持つ方。Trusted Guide たりうる方: 「自ら建てる」から「方向付け・レビュー・承認する」への発想転換を楽しみ、AIの生成物を的確に検証・判断できる方。高い当事者意識: 案件の成功に向けて自らプロセスと品質をコントロールするプロフェッショナリズムを持つ方。戦略的リーダーシップ: 文化や背景の異なる多国籍チームを統合し、共通のゴールへ力強く導ける方。


【セールスフォース・ジャパンの働きがいとダイバーシティ】

株式会社セールスフォース・ジャパンは、Great Place To Work® Institute Japan（GPTW）が発表した2026年版「働きがいのある会社」女性ランキングにおいて第2位に初ランクイン、また大規模部門（1,000人以上）においても第3位に選出されました。

私たちは「Equality（平等）」をコアバリューの一つとして掲げ、性別やライフステージに関わらず、すべての社員が能力を最大限に発揮できるインクルーシブな環境づくりを推進しています。社内コミュニティ「Salesforce Women’s Network（SWN）」をはじめとするネットワーキングやキャリア形成支援、メンターシップ制度も活発に稼働しています。


【柔軟な働き方・ワークライフバランスの推進】

  • ハイブリッドワーク / リモートワーク制度: 業務内容やチームの取り決めに応じた在宅勤務（リモートワーク）とオフィス勤務の柔軟な組み合わせが可能です。
  • フレックスタイム制度: コアタイムにとらわれない柔軟なスケジュール調整が可能で、育児や介護、個人のプライベートな事情に応じた働き方を尊重しています。
  • 充実した両立支援制度: 産前産後休暇・育児休業（女性の復職率は非常に高く、男性社員の育休取得実績も多数）、復職後の短時間勤務や看護・介護休暇など、ライフステージの変化に寄り添う各種サポートプログラムが整っています。
  • ウェルビーイング支援: 心身の健康を支援するウェルネス手当、社員サポートプログラム（EAP）など、持続可能なキャリアを支える包括的な福利厚生を提供しています。

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Account Executive - Agentforce Operations
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

At Salesforce, we're looking for exceptional, entrepreneurial Account Executives to help build and scale one of the most exciting emerging businesses in enterprise AI.

As part of Salesforce AI Labs, Regrello (Agentforce Operations) is redefining how the world's largest organisations operate, combining agentic AI, intelligent process orchestration and human expertise to transform complex business operations. With unprecedented speed and agility, Regrello enables enterprises to reimagine and transform complex processes in days rather than months.

This is not a traditional enterprise software sales role.

You'll be at the forefront of an emerging category, engaging directly with senior executives to challenge conventional thinking, shape ambitious transformation strategies and demonstrate how AI can fundamentally reinvent the way businesses operate.

We're looking for strategic thinkers, exceptional relationship builders and proven dealmakers who thrive on creating significant opportunities, navigating complexity and delivering transformational business outcomes.

Regrello (Agentforce Operations) is Salesforce's AI-native platform for transforming complex, mission-critical business operations, turning fragmented, manual processes into intelligent, end-to-end agentic workflows.

Enterprises can digitise processes in minutes rather than months, transforming unstructured documents, emails and existing workflows into digital process blueprints without code.

By orchestrating specialised AI agents, people and enterprise systems, Regrello enables organisations to automate and coordinate complex work across teams and functions, while maintaining human oversight, visibility and control.

Rather than simply automating individual tasks, Regrello empowers organisations to continuously reinvent how work gets done, moving from human-first to AI-first operations and unlocking new levels of productivity, efficiency and business agility.

This is a rare opportunity to help shape an emerging category in enterprise AI, combining the entrepreneurial energy of a high-growth business with the reach, credibility and resources of Salesforce.

You'll work alongside ambitious, innovative teams and engage with some of the world's most influential organisations, helping them fundamentally rethink how their businesses operate.

If you're driven by building something new, challenging the status quo, engaging visionary business leaders and delivering transformational impact, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Lead Strategic, Executive-Level EngagementsBuild trusted relationships with C-suite executives and senior business leaders, introducing bold ideas, challenging established thinking and inspiring new approaches to business transformation.Lead strategic conversations around customers' most pressing operational challenges, articulating compelling visions for how agentic AI can fundamentally reshape their businesses.Navigate complex enterprise organisations, influence senior decision-makers and build alignment across business, technology and executive stakeholders.
  • Create Demand and Build a New MarketChampion Regrello and the emerging category of agentic process orchestration, inspiring customers with a compelling vision for the future of enterprise operations.Proactively originate, develop and qualify high-value opportunities within strategic enterprise accounts, creating demand rather than simply responding to it.Combine creativity, commercial acumen and consultative selling to uncover transformational use cases, shape process transformation strategies and build compelling business cases.
  • Drive Value-Based, Transformational SalesLead with business outcomes, translating complex operational challenges into measurable financial impact and strategic value.Partner with customers to identify and prioritise high-impact processes across supply chain, manufacturing, finance, procurement and other critical business functions.Orchestrate compelling demonstrations, rapid proofs of concept and executive engagements that bring the transformative potential of agentic AI to life.
  • Own and Close Complex Enterprise DealsOwn the end-to-end sales lifecycle, from opportunity creation and executive engagement through to commercial negotiation and closing, working in close partnership with Salesforce's core account teams.Develop and execute sophisticated account strategies, navigating complex buying processes, influencing multiple stakeholders and securing executive sponsorship.Consistently exceed ambitious revenue targets while building a strong, sustainable pipeline of strategic enterprise opportunities.
  • Build Long-Term Strategic PartnershipsEstablish enduring customer relationships focused on measurable value creation, continuous innovation and long-term business transformation.Drive strategic account expansion by identifying opportunities to scale Regrello across additional processes, business functions and geographies.Collaborate with Salesforce executives, core Account Executives, Regrello's Agentic Operations Consultants, Solution Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers and Customer Success teams to drive strategic opportunities, accelerate customer outcomes and maximise long-term value.



You're Our Person If...

  • Exceptional sales performance: A proven track record of consistently exceeding ambitious revenue targets and personally originating, developing and closing significant, complex enterprise software deals.
  • Executive-level selling: Demonstrated success engaging C-suite executives, challenging conventional thinking and selling strategic, transformational solutions to senior business decision-makers.
  • Strategic business acumen: The ability to understand complex business operations, identify and prioritise high-value use cases, quantify financial impact and translate transformational opportunities into compelling business cases.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: A proactive, creative approach to creating demand, opening doors and developing opportunities rather than relying on an established pipeline.
  • Executive presence and storytelling: Exceptional communication and influencing skills, with the ability to articulate compelling visions, inspire confidence and create urgency for change.
  • Complex deal orchestration: Strong commercial instincts and negotiation skills, with the ability to align diverse stakeholders, mobilise internal resources and maintain momentum through sophisticated enterprise sales cycles.
  • Technical fluency and curiosity: The ability to understand and articulate complex technology concepts, connect technical capabilities to business outcomes and engage credibly with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Agility and ownership: The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, combining the entrepreneurial mindset of a startup with the scale and resources of Salesforce.



Even Better If...

  • Experience in high-growth enterprise technology businesses, particularly AI, automation, process intelligence, enterprise applications or digital transformation.
  • Strong understanding of business operations in industries such as manufacturing, financial services, life sciences, consumer goods or supply chain-intensive businesses.
  • A track record of introducing disruptive technologies, creating new markets or challenging established approaches to enterprise transformation.
  • Demonstrated success developing strategic enterprise accounts and expanding initial engagements into large-scale, enterprise-wide partnerships.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Sales careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards.

Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned experienced Sales Development Buddys who will provide hands-on coaching, invite you to join their discovery and qualification calls, giving you the confidence to pick up the phone to reach out to your first salesforce customers.   • You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset
  • You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning
  • You thrive in a team environment
  • You have excellent interpersonal skills
  • You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • You are fluent in English & Dutch (essential)

What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like?


The program is structured as follows:


Introduction Month


During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:

  • Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values
  • Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools
  • Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce
  • Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni

Rotations

The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path.
  • If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in Sales, you will then join the Solution Engineering Rotation from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. Over these six months, you will have built the fundamental skills for these complementary disciplines. Having gone deeper on your solution knowledge, learning how to demo and having exposure to later stages of the sales cycle during the solution engineering rotation will set you up for sucess as you promote throught the various sales roles - SDR, BDR, AE and beyond.
  • Throughout the rotations, there will be self-paced certifications and skills assessments. You must meet all eligibility criteria before you can panel for promotion.

  • Learn Salesforce’s best-in-class prospecting and qualification methodologies
  • Learn how to use social, digital, video, chat, and phone platforms to effectively engage Salesforce prospects
  • Collaborate with Sales Development Specialists to run campaigns and help build sales pipeline for the EMEA Sales organisation

  • Work closely with the Solution Engineering organisation, supporting the creation of cutting-edge customer demonstrations
  • Learn the art of customer discovery and how to create a compelling customer point of view

  • A clear and structured career path within our Sales organisation
  • The opportunity to work in an international team within a nurturing environment
  • Access to our diverse internal employee groups
  • A comprehensive benefits package
  • Relocation budget and guidance throughout your relocation process
  • An additional seven days of paid time off for charitable causes – learn more about our 1-1-1 model

With the EMEA Graduate Program – Sales Path, you can continue to progress:

As an Engineer on the AI Core team, you'll operate as a technical leader who turns ambiguous, high-stakes AI problems into durable, high-quality systems, while raising the technical bar for the broader team. AI Core builds the retrieval systems and agent infrastructure that power how our AI agents find, trust, and use knowledge, and the developer tooling that lets engineers across the company ship production agents quickly and safely. 


You'll lead significant initiatives end to end: faithful answering over a customer's own knowledge, retrieval that combines RAG and hybrid search, content lifecycle controls such as freshness, deduplication and source precedence, transcript processing, and the frameworks, registries, and evaluation tooling that make building a production agent a paved path. You'll partner closely with product, design, and engineering leadership to decide what we build, how we build it, and how we measure whether answers actually got better. 


What You'll Do 


Lead retrieval initiatives end to end: Design, build, and operate retrieval systems using RAG and hybrid search (lexical plus vector, reranking, filtering) so agents answer from the right content with the right amount of context. Own delivery from scope and design through launch, monitoring, and iteration. 


Build developer tooling for production agents: Drive technical design for the frameworks and platform pieces our engineers use to build agents, including multi-agent orchestration, shared primitives for prompts, tools, tracing, and evaluation. 


Own answer quality: Diagnose why answers are thin, wrong, or inconsistent by separating retrieval problems from generation problems (prompt, token budget, model choice). Set a quality bar we can test against, and lead the 

work to reach it. 


Design content and data models: Define how content from documents, 

knowledge bases, and call transcripts is ingested, segmented, labeled, and retrieved, including the primitives behind freshness, dedupe, source 

precedence, and internal versus external visibility. 


Make AI changes safe to ship: Build evaluation, observability, and rollout 

practices (offline evals, online monitoring, regression detection) so we can change prompts, models, and retrieval with confidence. Evaluate multiple 

solution paths and know when to trust, redirect, or override model and agent output. 


Set performance and scaling benchmarks across the platform we own: 


Define and track targets for retrieval and indexing, LLM provider usage, and agent orchestration. 


Own operational health: Ensure the reliability and performance of the systems your team owns. Participate in on-call, lead incident resolution for your area, and communicate clearly with the team and stakeholders during incidents. 


Use agentic development to raise leverage: Use coding agents by default for implementation, testing, refactoring, and documentation while holding a high validation bar. Create reusable workflows, patterns, and tooling that raise the effectiveness of your team beyond your own output. 


Partner across functions: Work with product, design, and engineering 

leadership to shape roadmap, tradeoffs, and requirements, and to translate strategy into concrete execution plans. 


Raise team effectiveness: Mentor engineers, give high-quality code review and technical guidance, and improve standards, tooling, and processes. 


Who You Are 


Proven experience shipping production AI or backend systems in a high ownership environment, with a recent focus on LLM-powered applications. 


Expertise building retrieval systems using RAG and hybrid search, including chunking and indexing strategy, embeddings, vector and lexical search, 

reranking, and measuring retrieval quality. 


Expertise building developer tooling that lets developers build production agents, which can include frameworks for multi-agent orchestration, an agent and tool registry, and shared infrastructure for tracing and evaluation. 

Experience owning platform initiatives from design through adoption, 

across systems such as retrieval and indexing, LLM provider integrations, and agent orchestration, including driving adoption and evolving the platform as usage grows. 


Demonstrated technical leadership: you lead significant projects, design solutions for non-trivial problems by weighing tradeoffs, and influence architecture and execution beyond your immediate workstream. 


Strong track record delivering complex projects with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, or phases. 


Strong backend engineering fundamentals and proficiency in languages such as Ruby on Rails, Python, JavaScript, or Go, with SQL and RDBMS experience (PostgreSQL preferred). 


Hands-on experience with the AI application lifecycle: experiment setup, dataset curation, offline evaluation, error analysis, deployment, and online evaluation. 


Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity: you can frame problems, propose solutions, and align others. 


Strong communicator across functions, able to explain technical ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences and to translate complex concepts into business impact. 


Ownership mindset and bias for action. You raise the bar for the team through mentoring, code review, and your own work. 


Curious and continuously learning, with an agent-forward approach to how you build software. 


Nice to Have


Experience with pgvector or other vector indexes, and with query performance at scale. 


Experience with content ingestion from third-party systems (document stores, knowledge bases, CRM knowledge objects) and the lifecycle problems that follow: sync state, dedupe, source conflict. 


Experience processing conversation or call transcripts, including handling PII and consent constraints. 


Experience designing evaluation suites that score qualities such as thoroughness and faithfulness, not only correctness. 


Experience with voice or real-time conversational agents. 


Experience with enterprise SaaS (especially B2B marketing or sales tech) or Salesforce/CRM integrations. 


Startup experience and rapid shipping. 


Why Join Qualified 


Foundational impact: Shape how our AI agents retrieve, reason, and answer, and the tooling every engineer here uses to build them. 


Lead real initiatives: Own significant projects end to end, with scope and 

influence that grow as you deliver. You'll own the platform as it scales, from retrieval to model providers to agent orchestration, and set the performance and reliability bar that grows with the company. 


AI as a core product surface: Turn new AI capabilities into dependable 

experiences that customers trust, with strong engineering around evaluation, observability, and iteration. 


High bar, low bureaucracy: Work with a team that values craft and decisive execution, where strong ideas win and shipping is the default. 


Room to grow: Take on larger technical and product scope over time: leading projects, influencing architecture, and leveling up quickly.
