About the Team

The Data 360 & Visualization Platform Operations team keeps the platforms that run Salesforce’s own business running. We operate Data 360, CRM Analytics, and Tableau, the data and analytics foundation for how Salesforce sells, serves, and makes decisions. We are Customer Zero: we run these products at enterprise scale first, and what we learn goes back to the product teams.

  • Keep it up. Monitoring, alerting, and frontline incident response that catch problems before customers do.
  • Make it stable. Root-cause analysis of recurring failures, plus closing security and compliance findings.
  • Run it well. Cataloging supported assets, tracking run costs, and keeping practices consistent.
  • Make it easy to get help. One clear way to ask for support, backed by automation and AI agents.
  • Be Customer Zero. Regular performance reviews, with the evidence fed to product and engineering.



What it’s like to start here: You’ll join a team that is rebuilding how it works, and you’ll help shape it. You’ll work in real production, on real incidents, with people who will teach you. You’ll start with well-scoped work: triaging cases, investigating failures, following and improving runbooks, and building monitors and automations. As you grow, you’ll own root-cause analysis and a piece of platform reliability. We write down what we learn, and we favor automation over manual effort.

Who thrives here: You’re curious, you like finding out why something happened, and you stay calm when something breaks. You explain technical issues clearly to non-technical people. We’ll teach you the platforms and the operating practices.

As a Systems Analyst, Data Foundations, you’ll independently run day-to-day production support and administration for Salesforce’s enterprise data and analytics platforms, working from established runbooks. You’ll own your case backlog, respond quickly and keep requesters informed, escalate with clear context, and help keep our support documentation accurate. You’ll grow toward owning escalations, root-cause analysis, and platform reliability.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Frontline Case, Alert & Escalation Management

  • Working with regional peers and leads, be among the first to respond to key signals and hand-raises from customers, agents, and alerts.
  • Start investigations, open issues, and help triage.
  • Be a frontline responder when an incident starts: connect first, gather evidence and impact, and swarm with the team alongside Incident Command. Follow the runbook to pull in Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) when needed. SREs own incident resolution.
  • Provide Tier-2 production support: ticket triage, case management, and keeping backlog health. You are measured on the intake and investigation lifecycle SLAs: First Response Time (FRT), Next Response Time (NRT), and Average Resolution Time (ART).
  • Support case and stakeholder satisfaction (CSAT, NPS) by communicating clearly, setting expectations, and closing the loop on every case.
  • Escalate cleanly on cases, intake, investigations, and gaps in SOPs: hand off to the right team with the evidence, impact, and steps already taken, and follow the escalation paths and time-zone handoffs in the runbooks. Growing toward owning escalations independently.



Platform Administration & Operations

  • Handle user provisioning, role hierarchy, and access management requests.
  • Troubleshoot declarative configuration, validation errors, and data discrepancies.
  • Execute scheduled data updates, bulk data loads and migrations, and basic sandbox maintenance.
  • Deliver moderate declarative solutions (for example Flows and validation rules) and platform enhancements.



Problem Management & Reliability

  • Contribute to RCAs, growing toward owning RCA and resolution for application bugs.
  • Help build and tune monitors, alerts, and automations. Flag technical debt and recommend fixes.



Process, Documentation & Playbooks

  • Follow and improve lightweight SOPs and Support Reference Manuals (SRMs), using team templates. Flag gaps and stale content, and draft updates from what you learn on cases.
  • Write knowledge articles and process maps so Tier-1/Tier-2 teams can reuse what you learn.
  • Map processes end to end with business partners.
  • Execute support playbooks as an SME and point of contact for development partners.



Security, SOX & Compliance

  • Follow security policies and change controls.
  • Execute technology compliance activities, audit reporting, and SOX reporting.
  • Follow the SDLC (Agile) and change, deployment, incident, and problem management processes.



Collaboration & Growth

  • Communicate clearly with business partners, engineers, and vendors across time zones.
  • Share knowledge and mentor new joiners.
  • Try new tools and practices, including automation and AI.



Flexibility

  • On-call and travel as required, subject to local regulations. Other related duties as required.



You're Our Person If...

  • Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
  • 1-3 years of hands-on platform or systems support experience in an enterprise IT environment.
  • Ability to perform core support tasks independently from SOPs and runbooks, and to escalate with clear context across teams and time zones.
  • Foundational knowledge of Salesforce native functionality: objects, access management, reports and dashboards, and data model administration.
  • Experience with declarative tools (Flow, validation rules) and data loading (Data Loader, Workbench).
  • Basic knowledge of Service Management practices (incident, problem, change).
  • Strong written and verbal communication, attention to detail, and follow-through.
  • Ability to work with growing independence in a distributed, global team.
  • Certifications (achieved or actively pursuing): Salesforce Administrator (ADM-201), Advanced Administrator (ADM-211), and Platform Developer I.


Even Better If...

  • Certifications: Data 360 and Tableau, plus other specialist or consultant certifications. Platform App Builder.
  • Hands-on experience with Data 360, Agentforce, CRM Analytics, or Tableau.
  • Exposure to major incidents or RCAs.
  • Intro-level coding (Apex, Python, SQL).
  • Experience in SOX-controlled environments.

Mexico City

Data and AI engineering

  • Develop MCP servers that give agents secure, governed access to Snowflake, Salesforce, and internal data catalogs. Use agents to keep documentation, lineage, and metadata current.
  • Supervise long-running agent tasks with checkpoints, cost controls, and audit trails. Contribute to agent-assisted modeling and simulation workflows, reviewing assumptions and uncertainty before decisions are acted on.

  • Proven use of AI coding assistants and generative AI to deliver measurably faster, with examples.

  • Sharp judgment to catch logic errors and hallucinations in AI-generated output before it reaches production.

As a Vulnerability Operations and Response Principal, you own the strategy, design, and continuous scaling of the enterprise vulnerability management framework across all internal business units, multi-cloud environments, and emerging AI and machine learning (ML) deployments. Modern high-scale software as a service (SaaS) and AI infrastructure demand a proactive, risk-driven approach to the vulnerability lifecycle that goes far beyond static compliance tracking. You serve as a technical authority and strategic operator, partnering with engineering, infrastructure, and product security groups to identify, prioritize, and neutralize infrastructure vulnerabilities, software flaws, and novel AI-specific security risks at cloud scale. You gain the opportunity to shape how a global enterprise secures its AI-forward platforms and to present your work directly to executive security leadership.

What You'll Actually Be Doing


  • Own the internal Vulnerability Operations roadmap end to end, driving strategy and execution for traditional infrastructure, container and microservice ecosystems, and secure development.
  • Build and enforce specialized security governance and vulnerability assessment frameworks for AI and ML workloads, including model supply chain risks, prompt injection pathways, shadow AI deployments, and data pipeline exposures.
  • Support critical vulnerability response operations, including leading high-profile vulnerability incidents and improving processes for your teams and partner teams during those incidents.
  • Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Architecture leaders across internal groups to build capabilities that minimize exposure to vulnerabilities across the entire vulnerability lifecycle.
  • Design techniques for continuous automated scanning, intelligent triage, and ticketing orchestration pipelines that eliminate manual overhead and streamline remediation without creating operational bottlenecks.
  • Report systemic posture trends, emerging AI threat vectors, model vulnerability metrics, and cross-group Service Level Agreement (SLA) performance directly to executive security leadership and C-level stakeholders.

You're Our Person If...

  • 8+ years of deep technical experience in enterprise vulnerability management, product security, infrastructure security, or security architecture at cloud scale.
  • A track record of running vulnerability response across a broad spectrum of stakeholders and keeping momentum even when there is no clear playbook.
  • Principal-level expertise in threat-informed vulnerability prioritization frameworks, including the Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS), the Exploit Prediction Scoring System (EPSS), and the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, and in modern vulnerability management lifecycles across diverse multi-tenant environments.
  • A strong understanding of emerging AI and ML architectures and security threat models, including large language model (LLM) security risks, frontier model-based attacks, supply chain vulnerabilities, and AI pipeline exposures.
  • Proven success influencing senior engineering and product stakeholders without direct authority to drive rapid, systemic remediation across complex enterprise software environments.
  • Clear communication of complex technical risk, systemic vulnerability findings, and strategic remediation roadmaps to executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders alike.
  • A bachelor's degree in a technical field such as computer science, cybersecurity, information systems, or engineering, or equivalent technical education.

Even Better If...


  • Experience building automated continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) security gating, automated ticket routing, and orchestration workflows.
  • Hands-on experience securing containerized environments such as Kubernetes and Docker, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and CloudFormation.

Salesforce is hiring a savvy communications professional, gifted writer, and sharp news reader to support our CEO’s most visible moments. This is the person who always knows what the world is saying about our company and industry. This is a rare seat at the center of Salesforce’s biggest narratives.

You’ll do two things well. First, you’ll help shape narrative strategy and turn it into words our CEO actually says and shares: fireside chats, earnings remarks, podcasts, media interviews, all-company meetings, and LinkedIn. Second, you’ll keep a constant read on the outside conversation, so we spot narratives early and respond with intent rather than react late.

You’ll join a high-trust team where everyone is close to the work and no two days look alike. You write cleanly and fast in someone else’s voice, have strong news judgment, and stay calm when a deadline moves up or the story changes overnight. A sense of humor and a team-first mindset help.

  • Ground everything in what’s been said. Use transcripts, coverage, and past remarks to keep content accurate and avoid contradicting ourselves.
  • Flag what matters, fast. Give our team timely, concise reads on emerging narratives, risks, and openings, including a short daily or weekly narrative brief. Recommend whether and how we should engage.

Afterward, flag takeaways and follow-ups, help with fact-checking, and capture strong soundbites for the messaging bank.

  • 8+ years in executive communications, speechwriting, corporate communications, journalism, or a similar field. Experience writing for a CEO or other senior spokesperson strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional writing and editing. A portfolio of speeches, talk tracks, op-eds, or executive messaging that is concise, compelling, and clearly in someone else’s voice.
  • Executive social media expertise. Proven experience running LinkedIn for a senior leader: writing posts that sound like the person, planning a content calendar, and using engagement data to improve results.

Our Financial Services Industry Architecture team works on Salesforce’s largest and most complex banking, insurance, and wealth management customers. We don’t stop at showing customers what’s possible; we prove it by building it with them. Success here is a working prototype or a deployed asset, not a great deck.


As a Principal AI & Integrated Solutions Architect, you will be the trusted technical lead for a set of strategic FS accounts. You’ll help design agentic AI architectures that hold up under real scrutiny: governed multi-agent systems, headless and API-first experiences, and unified data and integration patterns that span Agentforce, Data 360, MuleSoft, and the customer’s existing systems. You’ll work across the full engagement. That means framing the problem with C-level and Chief Architect stakeholders, building the prototype that proves the value, and handing it off cleanly to partners and delivery teams so it scales into production and becomes a reusable play for the whole organization.


You’ll sit within an FS segment team and belong to the broader Regulated Industries architecture community. That gives you exposure to patterns and peers across financial services, healthcare, life sciences, and the public sector.

What you’ll do:


Lead agentic AI architecture on strategic accounts (≈30%). Serve as the aligned architect for your accounts. Run discovery and org assessments, set the current- and future-state architecture, and own architectural direction from first conversation through production handoff. Shape decisions on agent orchestration, MCP and agent-to-agent interoperability, headless and composable design, data foundations, and the trust and governance layer.


Build to prove value (≈25%). Co-build working prototypes and proof-of-value assets on customers’ own data and objects, using modern AI-assisted development tools. Turn a hypothesis into something a business sponsor can see and use within weeks, not quarters.


Run and extend our engagement plays (≈15%). Deliver our defined engagement models. These cover the economics of an agentic operating model, headless experiences that keep governance intact, governed multi-agent systems at enterprise scale, and executive North Star architecture. Add new content and reusable components back to the shared library, so each engagement leaves the next one further ahead.


Own the handoff and the path to scale (≈10%). Package architecture, data dictionaries, process maps, and agent metadata so that partners, SIs, and delivery teams can take the work to production without losing the design intent. Hold clear entry and exit gates so delivery stays planned and predictable.

Advise executives on FS outcomes (≈10%). Translate architecture into business value for CIOs, CTOs, Chief Architects, and line-of-business leaders. Fit designs to FS regulatory, data residency, model risk, and operating-model constraints. Represent Salesforce at executive briefings, architecture review boards, and industry events.


Elevate the team and the field (≈10%). Mentor architects and account teams. Contribute points of view, reference architectures, and reusable assets. Work closely with AEs, SEs, Professional Services, forward-deployed engineers, partners, and product teams, with each role doing its own job well.

Architecture-sourced pipeline and measurable progression on priority opportunities in your accounts.

Agentforce and Data 360 consumption milestones reached and tied to customer outcomes.


Prototypes that convert into production commitments and reusable plays adopted by other architects.

Customers who treat you as their go-to architecture advisor, shown by repeat engagement and sponsorship from executive and Chief Architect stakeholders.

Disciplined engagement records, so your impact is visible and credited.

  • 10+ years in enterprise or solution architecture, including significant customer-facing work in financial services: banking, insurance, wealth/asset management, or payments.

  • Practical, current experience designing and building AI solutions. This includes LLM-based agents, retrieval and grounding, agent orchestration, and emerging interoperability standards such as MCP and A2A.
  • Builder credibility. You personally prototype using code (Apex, JavaScript/Node, Python, or similar) and AI-assisted development tools, and you’re comfortable working in Git-based workflows.
  • Working knowledge of FS regulatory and risk requirements: privacy, data residency, model risk management, auditability, and AI governance. You also know how these requirements shape architecture decisions.
  • Executive presence. You can hold a contested architecture debate with a Chief Architect and move it to a decision.
  • A team-first operating style. You’re comfortable working within aligned coverage, sharing assets, and making others better.

Nice to have:

  • Salesforce certifications: Application Architect and/or System Architect required (or equivalent), plus relevant Cloud Consultant certifications; working towards Certified Technical Architect (CTA) is highly valued

As Manager, Art Direction on the Integrated Campaigns Creative team, you will lead day-to-day design and art direction for Salesforce's Missionforce marketing initiatives, managing a team of two Senior Designers while remaining actively involved in hands-on creative development and execution.


Missionforce is Salesforce's AI-powered platform for government, public sector, defense, and national security organizations.   • Ability to balance hands-on creative work, team leadership, and multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

You drive approval rule design strategy, team capacity allocation, and execution timelines. You ensure our approval rule architecture supports growing business needs and maintains strict Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • People Leadership: You lead a team of configuration specialists. You manage the team's capacity allocation while establishing a high-performance culture through coaching, feedback, and career development.
  • Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC): You oversee the end-to-end SDLC for approval rule configurations. You establish deployment frameworks, Quality Assurance standards, peer review protocols, and release controls to ensure high configuration accuracy, business continuity, and zero production downtime.
  • Stakeholder & Project Management: You lead projects from inception through delivery, and partner with business and Information Technology leadership to align on strategic priorities and solution architectures.
  • SOX & Risk Management: You own the operational control framework for SOX compliance across approval rule systems. You ensure team adherence to change-management protocols and lead team engagement with internal and external auditors.
  • Operational Excellence: You establish and track team performance metrics (e.g., production incident volume, cycle times, error rate) and use them to scale the team throughput as volume grows.



You're Our Person If...

  • People Leadership: You have 3+ years of experience directly managing or developing teams in technical operations, revenue operations, or business systems, with 7+ years of overall operational experience.
  • Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) Management: You have 3+ years of experience managing enterprise software configuration delivery pipelines, including architectural review, intake prioritization, User Acceptance Testing frameworks, change control, release management, and ongoing production support.

descriptionHtml:

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience


The Renewals Team is responsible for managing and forecasting the entire book of renewals business. They forecast and track renewals trends and highlight adoption issues for the company.

The Renewals team partners with sales, customer success manager and support to execute retention strategy. They are responsible for conducting account review, risk assessment and due diligence while developing a renewal strategy. Renewal team members take ownership and maintenance of all renewal opportunities (direct customers and indirect through resellers), forecasting, negotiation, generate upsell/cross sell opportunities, engaging internal resources and closing renewals prior to contract expiration.

As a Scale Renewals Manager you start to handle a large number of renewals. Volume of contracts managed each month tends to be around 50 ~ 100(depends on assigned territory) for Direct and Reseller’s customers in Japan, Korea and Taiwan. You own driving the renewal to completion. You partner with the account team and develop a renewals strategy for every customer. You build quotes, review contract terms, negotiate pricing, look for up-sell opportunities, and handle objections. It is also needed to plan how to improve the current operation process and manage some contractors or outsource partners who are doing renewal management for small size of contracts .

You will be measured on renewal rate, contract term length, and KSO (Key Strategic Objectives) driving specific sales goals of your renewals and ability to negotiate favorable terms.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Drive all managed renewals thoroughly in assigned territory by identify risk as early as possible as well as generating revenue growth opportunity via add-on, upsell, upgrade, price adjustment (working location is Japan Tokyo Office)
  • Achieve or exceed monthly renewal targets and provide senior management with an accurate forecast and risk analysis of all assigned accounts
  • Develop and execute win/win negotiation strategies for contract renewals that maximize contract value while protecting and enhancing the customer relationship
  • Build strong working relationships across Sales and Customer Success Group Leadership
  • Closely monitor at risk accounts. Work with Customer Success, Support, and Services leadership to resolve customer issues and help remove barriers for the team
  • Serve as point of escalation for critical customer issues; provide summary of the overall ‘health’ of the account and use of our services
  • Answer customer questions and successfully negotiate issues related to renewal contracts
  • Attend and lead monthly regional calls to discuss renewal forecast, top renewals, at risk accounts (if required)
  • Managing some contractors or outsource partners to deal with high transaction volume customers.
  • Help develop and educate renewal best practices across the team
  • Maximize account growth opportunities by playing an active role on the account team and helping to identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities upon contract renewal
  • Own, drive and manage the renewals process in collaboration with the account team
  • Work with internal resources (Competitive Intelligence, Pricing, Product Management, Customer Success, Account Executives, etc…) to develop comprehensive ‘win’ strategies for renewals
  • Identify customer requirements, uncover roadblocks, and demonstrate strong account management capabilities to drive renewal to on-time closure
  • Communicate risk clearly and take the lead in developing resolution strategies
  • Accurately maintain a rolling 180 day weekly forecast of renewals of your territory



You're Our Person If...

  • High-level fluency in Japanese language (speaking, reading, writing, listening)
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills (TOEIC 730+ )
  • 3 years or relative experience or sales/account and/or renewal management experience from a software or SI/solution Selling industry are preferable.
  • Vast knowledge or experience of Business Application (CRM/SFA/MA experience as user/sales is preferable)
  • Fundamental understanding of Salesforce product solutions
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Considerable interpersonal skills are mandatory, including the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with others
  • Strong negotiation skills that allow for value-based contract negotiations
  • Knowledge of restructuring contract term and condition relating legal, finance and billing
  • Excellent computer skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Google Apps)
  • Degree or Relevant Work Experience Preferred



Leadership Qualities

  • PASSION: Passionate about Customer Success
  • BEGINNERS MIND: Always learning, approaches each interaction with open mind, great listener and hands-on
  • LEADERSHIP: Self-aware and strategic thinker; proficient at building strong relationships
  • TEAM PLAYER: Proficient at collaboration and working with members of a team
  • URGENCY: Ability to move fast and drive business value and results
  • OHANA: Embodies Aloha culture: A team player that everyone enjoys working with and has a generous heart
  • TRUST: Trust the company’s core values
  • ADAPTABLE: Excels in high levels of uncertainty and change

【セールスフォース・ジャパンの働きがいとダイバーシティ】
株式会社セールスフォース・ジャパンは、Great Place To Work® Institute Japan（GPTW）が発表した2026年版「働きがいのある会社」女性ランキングにおいて第2位に初ランクイン、また大規模部門（1,000人以上）においても第3位に選出されました。

Mid Commercial (201 - 1000 employees)

Overview

Are you passionate about data and technology, but also care deeply about doing something meaningful? Come join the Salesforce Analytics Solution Engineering team, supporting our Commercial business across AMER (Financial Services) and Canada (all industries). Through collaboration with the customer, Sales, Product, and Professional Services, our Solutions Engineers (SEs) engage across the entire customer lifecycle and drive the technical sale of Analytics and Tableau solutions that turn data into action and help customers connect with their own customers in new ways. This is a role for someone naturally curious, adaptable, and passionate about AI and our agentic future. The ideal candidate balances technical depth with sales strategy and is comfortable presenting to a data analyst and a C-suite executive. If you enjoy a fast-paced environment full of exciting challenges and opportunities to build compelling solutions, the Analytics Solution Engineering team is for you — a dynamic, constantly evolving world where design, business consulting, and technology expertise drive innovation every day.


Why Join Us? 

The Salesforce Analytics platform is a key innovation driver in the Agentic world, and is as much a philosophy as it is an amazing suite of tools, including Tableau and CRM Analytics. We enable people to transform data into something visual and understandable, empowering them to make important decisions based on those insights. Our products are key in helping organizations with data to see, understand, and act on data. Our core values—trust, customer success, innovation, equality, and sustainability—guide all our actions as a company and as individuals.

The ideal Analytics Solution Engineer candidate is a challenger, naturally curious, and has a strong desire to demonstrate their technical and/or sales skills, including the ability to solicit business requirements, develop a technical sales strategy, configure and successfully demonstrate the Salesforce Analytics solutions that address these requirements and provide business value through compelling storytelling.

  • A Solution Engineer plays a pivotal role in the sales process by aligning innovative strategies to technology solutions within complex accounts through masterful storytelling.   • Innovation Management: Bring focus to a client's decision making process by communicating and evaluating solution options, and driving consensus among key collaborators. In some instances, we help our clients develop new decision frameworks and governance processes that continue to deliver value far beyond a particular engagement.
  • Connect Experiences: Demonstrate through software demos and rapid prototyping how connected experiences come to life with The Salesforce Solutions.   • "Solutioning" is fundamental to the SE role.   • Discover the customer's business needs, and position the best Salesforce solution to achieve those business objectives

  • Develop and deliver the story of the customer experience aided by Salesforce technologies
  • Participate in all appropriate product, sales, and procedural training and certifications to acquire and maintain the knowledge vital to be effective in the position

  • Exceptional oral, written, presentation, collaboration, interpersonal and communication skills
  • Ability to be adaptable and work as part of a team to solve technical problems in a dynamic and fast-moving industry

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Direct experience with Salesforce CRM Analytics and/or Tableau Cloud/Server/Next

The Experience

Join an agile team with deep startup roots. We operate as a high-velocity ‘startup-within-Salesforce,’ following our recent acquisition. You’ll be managed by the same founders and engineers who built the original company, offering the autonomy of a small team backed by the global scale and trust of Salesforce.

We have successfully moved past the "0 to 1" phase. We have a product that works, customers who love it, and the backing of Salesforce. Now, we are entering the "1 to 100" phase: scaling our architecture to handle global demand, hardening our systems for enterprise-grade resilience, and integrating deeply with our ecosystem. This is your chance to help lead that transition.


What You'll Actually Be Doing

As a Production Support Engineer (PMTS), you will be a senior technical member of staff within our embedded reliability team. You aren’t building the foundation alone—you’ll work alongside a group of engineers and product owners to ensure the platform is the most reliable AI-powered engine in the industry.


This is a role for an engineer who loves the "scaling" problem. You will focus on production excellence, performance tuning, and infrastructure automation. Because you are embedded in the product organization, you’ll have a seat at the table during design reviews, ensuring that as we add new agentic capabilities, they are built to scale from day one.

We want people who have a proven track record of delivering real, measurable outcomes and get excited about the prospect of getting to own and steer the direction of our technical architecture. 

  • Scaling & Reliability: Own the reliability roadmap for major product areas, working to transition our systems from startup-speed architectures to highly-available, global-scale enterprise solutions.
  • Technical Leadership: As a Principal-level member of technical staff, the team will be expecting you to provide the expert insights to help guide and steer the technical direction of our team. 
  • Mentorship: The LMTS and SMTS members of our team will be looking to provide both formal mentorship via direct engagement as well as informal mentorship via setting a high bar of technical excellence. This is not a role where you will work in a silo - close collaboration amongst the team is required and expected and it will be your job to initiate that.  
  • Infrastructure as Code: Maintain and evolve our automated environments, focusing on making our "infrastructure-as-plugins" model more robust and developer-friendly.
  • AI Operations (AIOps): Support the scaling of our AI/ML infrastructure, ensuring our models have the GPU resources and data pipelines required to deliver real-time supply chain insights.
  • Production Excellence: Lead the "1 to 100" hardening of our observability stack. You won’t just respond to incidents; you’ll build the tooling that prevents them and the telemetry that explains them.
  • Performance Engineering: Deep-dive into SQL optimization, API latency, and cross-service communication to ensure our data-intensive supply chain platform remains performant under heavy load.
  • AI-First Workflow: Lean into the future of engineering by using AI tools (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) to automate routine operational tasks and accelerate infrastructure delivery.

You're Our Person If...

  • 9+ years of experience in SRE, Production Engineering, or Backend Engineering with a heavy focus on operations and scale.
  • Proven Scaling Experience: You have previously helped take a product through a high-growth phase (the "1 to 100" journey), dealing with the technical debt and architectural shifts that come with it.
  • Effective Communicator: This is an integral role within our organization as you’ll be responsible for implementing the product vision and then communicating that reality back to a variety of stakeholders with varying degrees of technical expertise. As such, strong communication abilities are a must. 
  • Coding Mastery: You are an expert in writing production-grade code in either Golang, TypeScript, or Python—you view automation as a software engineering problem.
  • Technical Breadth: Strong proficiency in Kubernetes, Terraform/OpenTofu, and AWS/GCP/Azure.
  • Observability Expert: Demonstrated experience with properly instrumenting applications and platforms with SLO-based monitoring and alerting. 
  • Systems Expert: Deep understanding of distributed systems, including how to debug complex interactions between microservices, databases, and AI agents.
  • Low-Ego Collaboration: Experience working within a senior team of Principal engineers, capable of both leading specific initiatives and supporting the broader group’s technical vision.
  • AI Fluency: A demonstrated ability to use modern AI development tools to move faster and build more reliable systems.
  • Ownership Mentality. We are a senior team who operate with a high degree of autonomy. As a result, we’re looking for someone who can independently identify issues and own the solution all the way through final implementation.  

Even Better If...

  • M.S. in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Database Specialist: Strong experience with PostgreSQL at scale (partitioning, indexing, query tuning).
  • Distributed Systems: Advanced knowledge of microservice orchestration and durability patterns, including hands-on experience with Temporal for workflow reliability and Istio service meshes for secure, observable service-to-service communication in high-growth SaaS environments.
  • Monitoring and Observability: Tracing, profiling, monitoring, logging, dashboard creation - we’re looking for someone who has demonstrated prior results across a wide breadth of the monitoring and observability stack. Specific experience in Prometheus, Grafana, and Pagerduty is desired. 
  • Search Indexing: Prior experience with Elastisearch implementations or Typesense.
  • Salesforce Knowledge: Familiarity with Salesforce infrastructure, Hyperforce, or Data Cloud is a plus.

The Enterprise Corporate Sales (ECS) Account Executive is responsible for selling into local government clients across the Netherlands. This role is ideal for individuals looking to develop their enterprise sales experience by working closely with our most seasoned sales executives. With a collaborative sales model and a supportive environment, this is an excellent opportunity to accelerate your sales career.


At Salesforce, customer success is at the heart of everything we do. You will receive comprehensive onboarding and induction into the business. In addition to your own business development efforts, you will be supported by a wide range of resources, including internal sales support and highly skilled solution engineers. You will never be working alone.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets by selling the Salesforce portfolio into accounts within a defined set of Dutch local government organisations (such as municipalities and provincial bodies).
  • Manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting to close, ensuring delivery against key performance metrics. Focus on both new business development and expanding existing accounts.
  • Identify and research key accounts and local government verticals to develop a targeted go-to-market strategy and generate qualified opportunities.
  • Build a strong pipeline through a combination of outbound activities including cold calling, email campaigns, and leveraging local government insights.
  • Maintain an accurate and up-to-date sales pipeline to support consistent overachievement.
  • Engage with prospective organisations using value-based selling techniques, including business case development, ROI analysis, customer references, and industry data.
  • Collaborate with internal teams such as Sales Engineers, Professional Services, Executives, and Partners to manage the entire sales process.
  • Deliver short-term results while maintaining a long-term view to maximise overall revenue growth.
  • Ensure all customer and pipeline data is accurately updated in Salesforce.
  • Provide accurate weekly forecasts and revenue reporting.

About You:

  • Extensive experience selling enterprise software solutions, ideally within a major technology vendor.
  • Proven track record of securing new business and consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Skilled in managing complex sales cycles and closing high-impact deals.
  • Passionate about working with local government organisations in the Netherlands, with a deep understanding of their unique challenges, regulatory landscape, and opportunities.

What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters

Global Technology Partnerships (GTP) is seeking a dedicated Business Operations Specialist to manage escalated operational support for our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) partners. This role will be a pivotal part of our newly relaunched escalated support efforts for our ecosystem of 7,500+ Independent Software Vendor (ISV) partners. This involves rethinking the way we manage partners at-scale, finding ways to unlock "self-serve" for partners, and ultimately acting as the escalation point for complex or high priority cases. As the main escalation point, you will drive timely and high-impact solutions for our partners, ensuring seamless communication, efficient issue resolution, and a world-class partner experience.

In this role, you will be primarily focused on cases where automated support processes cannot resolve issues, ensuring that our highest priority ISV partners receive timely and effective operational support for complex challenges. Working in close collaboration with Partner Account Managers and Technical Advisors, you will oversee escalations related to partner needs, such as: partner benefit offerings, partner access and tools, program questions, order and billing support, compliance initiatives and partner off-boarding. You will also collaborate with the Scale Operations Escalation Leader to drive improvements to our "at scale" approach, continually finding ways to get partners the information they need when they need it, and ultimately driving down escalation volume across the ISV team.

Core Responsibilities & Scope

  • Reactive Ecosystem Support: Provide timely, reactive support to address partner escalations within Salesforce's ISV ecosystem, ensuring critical issues are resolved quickly and effectively.
  • Case Routing & Coordination: Manage the case routing, prioritization, and escalations process for ISV support cases, ensuring timely resolution within Salesforce's Partner Agreement SLAs.
  • Operational Support & Communication: Deliver timely and clear communication to ISV partners on escalated case status, next steps, and resolution timelines.
  • Escalation & Resolution Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for high-complexity or high-risk ISV partner escalations, coordinating efforts with Partner Account Managers and other internal Salesforce teams.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration & Solution Seeking: Partner closely with internal teams, including Product, Technical Advisors, Legal, and Support, to align on escalated cases and develop holistic, scalable solutions for ISV partners.
  • Process Optimization: Identify opportunities for process improvements within Salesforce's scale operations to streamline escalated support and improve partner satisfaction.
  • Reporting & Documentation: Maintain accurate records of partner interactions, case details, and resolution steps; generate regular reports to analyze escalation trends and solution effectiveness. Document best practices and processes in Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) documents.



Minimum Requirements

  • Experience: 3+ years in customer service, partner operations, or escalated support functions, preferably within a Salesforce or ISV support environment.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Demonstrated ability to analyze, creatively problem-solve, and resolve complex partner escalations.
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with an ability to convey technical and operational information clearly to ISV partners.
  • Collaboration & Relationship Building: Proven ability to collaborate across departments and work closely with Partner Account Managers to support ISV partners effectively.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing partner needs and business requirements.
  • Technical Acumen: Familiarity with Salesforce's platform and ISV ecosystem is preferred, as well as an understanding of order and billing support and compliance requirements.
  • Education: Degree or equivalent confirmed experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.).

  • Experience with Salesforce CRM and case management tools.

They are not afraid to dig into the inner workings of our platform to answer a challenging question or address an objection, and are equally comfortable speaking to a room of software developers as they are to the CIO & CTO.

As hands-on technical leaders, TAs take an active role in leading and executing Proof of Concepts (POCs) during customer engagements, working alongside the pre-sales team to demonstrate real-world value and validate solution approaches. They translate customer requirements into working prototypes, leveraging their deep technical expertise to de-risk implementations and accelerate time-to-value.

They are willing to be honest about potential challenges and always keep the long-term success of the customer in mind. People who enjoy both working with technology in a deep way and relating to people will excel in this role. Curiosity, communication, and capacity for learning are key pillars for successful TAs.

The SMB EMEA Technical Architect works with Salesforce’s Small & Medium Business (SMB) customers across all industries. We work in a fast-paced, team-driven collaborative environment where everyone brings something unique to the table to get the job done.

• Navigate public sector buying paths, including cooperative contracts (e.g. NASPO ValuePoint), reseller partners and agency-specific RFPs.

• Shape solutions across Salesforce's platform, including Agentforce, Data Cloud, Service Cloud and industry solutions for Public Sector, with your SE and partners.

• Forecast accurately and keep a clean, honest pipeline in Salesforce.

Land and expand

• Turn first wins into lighthouse references, then use them to expand across agencies and toward enterprise-wide agreements.

• Work with Customer Success and partners to make sure every customer goes live and gets value, because in a small state, every reference travels.

What you bring

• 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise software sales, with at least 3 selling into state or local government.

• A record of building a territory from scratch. You can walk us through a time you started with no pipeline and a list of names, and what you built from it.

• Exceptional account planning. You think in agency org charts, budget cycles and multi-year roadmaps, and you write plans other people can actually execute against.

• Executive presence. You're credible in the room with a cabinet secretary or state CIO, you listen more than you pitch, and you can tie technology to mission outcomes like faster benefits, shorter wait times and stronger compliance.

• Perseverance. Public sector cycles run 12 to 24 months. You stay curious and consistent through stalled budgets, RFP delays and leadership turnover, and you treat "not yet" as information, not rejection.

• Public sector buying fluency, including RFPs, cooperative purchasing vehicles, reseller partners and the role of the legislature in funding.

• Partner savvy. You know how to co-sell with SIs and resellers and make them want to bring you into their accounts.

• Willingness to travel regularly across WY, ND and SD. Based in or near the territory (or the Rocky Mountain region) is preferred.

Nice to have

• Existing relationships with state agencies in WY, ND, SD or neighboring states.

• Experience selling CRM, case management or platform solutions into Health and Human Services, Labor, Revenue, Transportation or Public Safety.

• Familiarity with modernization themes like legacy mainframe replacement, federal compliance frameworks and AI adoption in government.

• Salesforce ecosystem experience, as a customer, partner or seller.

What success looks like

• First 90 days: a written territory plan, priority agencies identified, and executive meetings on the calendar in all three states.

• First 6 months: qualified pipeline across multiple agencies, with active partner co-sell motions and at least one opportunity in procurement.

• First 12 months: first lighthouse customer signed and live, a reference you can take to the next agency, and a clear path toward a multi-agency agreement.

Why this role

You'll get the autonomy of building something new with the backing of a team that has done it before in neighboring states. You'll have a leader who joins you in the field, an SE partner invested in your wins, and a front-row seat as AI changes how government serves people.


Day to Day

Our Enterprise Account Executives engage with existing customers and new leads to sell the entire Salesforce Customer 360 platform. They build positive, trusted relationships with both key team members and c-suite decision makers within their patch, and become naturals at helping customers realize value from their Salesforce investments.


You will use your skills to develop opportunities, through both warm leads and whitespace prospecting.


      • Develop key customer stakeholder relationships and drive customer satisfaction at assigned accounts
      • Develop and drive the overall long-term strategy for the account, aligned to customer business objectives
      • Coordinate internal Salesforce resources to meet customer business needs

What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters

MuleSoft's Customer Support team is looking for talented individuals with a passion for researching complex technologies and a track record of high customer satisfaction to help our team drive customer success with MuleSoft products. We maintain an extremely high level of satisfaction across our customer base, and we take great pride in our operational efficiency and the strength of the solutions we provide to our customers.

As a member of the Support team, you will leverage advanced technical expertise to resolve complex platform-related issues affecting customers. As a Senior Technical Support Engineer expert, you will enable customer success by helping our customers to overcome crippling technical challenges. You will provide hands-on troubleshooting, feature explanation, and best practice guidance to the broader Technical Support team to assist customers during critical and time-sensitive situations while partnering with development teams.

You'll find yourself researching new technologies every day, including Web Services, HTTP, JMS, JEE application servers, and many types of Enterprise Software. This role will give you an opportunity to build expertise and fast-track your career toward customer-facing technical roles, and your successes will have an impact across the company.

Work Hours: The candidate primarily needs to work US East or US Central shift. However, we are a 24x7 Support Hub, the candidate hence needs to be ready to work any shift based on business requirements.

Note: this role is office-flexible, and the expectation is to be in-office a minimum of three (3) days per week.

Core Responsibilities & Scope

  • Take ownership of customer issues through to resolution - including troubleshooting, internal communication, and providing meaningful feedback on a regular basis to assist with troubleshooting integrations involving third-party APIs and implementation of other products.
  • Liaise and work closely with the internal teams on escalated technical issues and product roadmap changes/new features.
  • Provide feature explanation and implementation best practices.
  • Create knowledge base materials dedicated to operational efficiency while empowering and enabling the developer community.
  • Respond promptly and effectively to technical support requests from clients regarding integration API-related issues.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues, offering timely and accurate solutions to ensure minimal disruption to clients' operations.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including developers and operations, to resolve complex integration challenges.
  • Document and track support cases, solutions, and interactions in our support systems to maintain accurate records.
  • Escalate critical issues to development teams when necessary, ensuring timely resolution.



Minimum Requirements

  • Must be a US citizen on US soil and not a citizen of another country (dual citizen). No exceptions. Do not apply if you don't meet these requirements.
  • Must be able to obtain authorization to work on US government support cases
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of REST and SOAP web-based services, with a working knowledge of WSDL interpretation, generation, and consumption.
  • Experience troubleshooting Internet technologies: HTTP, firewalls, web servers, proxy servers, etc.
  • In-depth knowledge of database concepts and data management (RDBMS) and SQL.
  • Proven analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to effectively prioritize and escalate customer issues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.



Preferred Qualifications

  • MuleSoft Certifications (MCD 1, MCD 2) are a plus
  • Knowledge and troubleshooting experience with at least one programming language, such as Java, .NET, or PHP, and analyzing thread dumps and heap dumps as an added advantage.
  • Use of AI Tools for troubleshooting, problem discovery, and automation
  • Must have experience in Java development and concepts, including debugging against Java APIs, providing technical solutions, examining thread dumps and threading issues, and hosting services using JEE and/or JSE framework
  • Experience with JEE Application Servers and Containers (administration, deployment, and/or development in Tomcat, JBoss, WebSphere, Spring, etc.)

The Role

Come join the Salesforce Analytics Solution Engineering team and become the senior technical voice of Tableau for our SMB customers across EMEA.

As a Senior Analytics Specialist Solution Engineer, you will partner with Account Executives, Analytics sales specialists, and customers to win and grow Salesforce's analytics business across Small Business and Growth Business accounts. You will cover the full analytics portfolio: Tableau Cloud, Tableau Server, Tableau Next, and CRM Analytics, plus the power of the Tableau platform on Data 360 and Slack. You will show customers how to see, understand, and act on their data, including through agentic experiences.

SMB is fast and high-velocity. You will run many conversations at once, move quickly from discovery to a live demo, and help customers reach value without long enterprise sales cycles. As a senior member of the team, you are expected to operate with little oversight, set the technical standard for the region, and help the people around you grow. You are not just supporting the deal. You are helping drive it, and you share ownership of the number.


What You'll Do

* Own the technical sale for analytics in SMB EMEA. Lead discovery, define the technical strategy, and win the technical decision across Tableau Cloud, Server, Next, and CRM Analytics.

* Drive revenue alongside your AEs. Help qualify and build pipeline, shape deal strategy, contribute to forecast accuracy, and move opportunities to close. You are accountable for results, not just activity.

* Demo live and build hands-on. Deliver compelling, tailored demos and rapid prototypes for audiences from analysts to business owners to C-level executives. You are happiest with your hands on the keyboard.

* Tell the story of the platform. Make complex architecture simple and engaging, showing how Tableau, Data 360, Slack, and agentic experiences connect to turn data into decisions and action.

* Advise on data and analytics architecture. Understand each customer's data landscape and advise on how Salesforce and Tableau solutions fit into it.

* Solve ambiguous problems. Take messy business challenges, define the problem, size the opportunity, and recommend practical next steps.

* Bring clarity to customer decisions. Evaluate solution options, align stakeholders, and build consensus, including guiding customers between Tableau Cloud, Server, Next, and CRM Analytics.

* Show agency. Spot gaps in process, content, demo assets, or a deal, and fix them before anyone has to ask.

* Mentor and multiply. Coach newer SEs, share reusable demos and assets, run enablement sessions, and make the whole region better. Help shape how the SMB EMEA analytics team operates.

* Partner across the business. Work with Sales, Product, Professional Services, and partners, and bring customer and field feedback back to Product.

* Stay current. Complete the product, sales, and certification training needed to stay sharp on a fast-moving portfolio.

* Travel occasionally for customer engagements and team events.


What We're Looking For


Required

* A technical degree (Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS, Data Science, or similar) or equivalent experience. We evaluate experience against the core competencies of the role, including work, leadership, military, and volunteer experience.

* [6+ years of professional experience, including 4+ years in a solution engineering, sales engineering, BI/analytics consulting, or data analyst role]

* Deep, hands-on experience with Tableau, CRM Analytics, or Tableau Next, including data visualization, dashboarding, and self-service analytics best practices, plus strong knowledge of relational databases, data modeling, and web technologies.

* A track record of influencing and closing technical sales, with experience owning the technical win in a deal.

* Agency: you see a problem and fix it before anyone schedules a meeting about it.

* Builder mindset: deep technical aptitude and a strong preference for building, configuring, and demoing yourself.

* Numbers focus: revenue belongs to SEs too. You are comfortable owning outcomes, working a pipeline, and being measured on results.

* Storytelling: exceptional presentation and communication skills, including the ability to make complex architecture simple. You are a strategic problem solver, comfortable engaging technical, business, and executive audiences.

* Team-first mindset: you collaborate well, lift up those around you, and are comfortable mentoring others.

* Fluency in English.

* Valid passports and/or residency to travel occasionally across Europe for work.


Preferred

* Additional languages: fluency in one or more of Spanish, French, or German (or another EMEA language) is a bonus.

* Previous experience as a solution or sales engineer or consultant at a CRM, analytics, or BI company, or in a similar customer-facing technical role.

* Current Tableau and Salesforce certifications (e.g. CRM Analytics, Data 360 / Data Cloud).

* Experience across the analytics portfolio: Tableau Cloud, Server, Next, and CRM Analytics.

* Familiarity with Data 360, Slack, and AI/agentic use cases in analytics.

* Familiarity with AI/ML fundamentals and how analytics platforms surface AI-driven insights (e.g. predictive analytics and agentic AI).

* Experience building with AI tools (e.g. Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT) as part of your demo and prototyping toolkit.

* Experience with SQL and data modeling across structured and semi-structured data.

* Basic programming or scripting experience (Python, JavaScript, HTML, or similar).

* Experience with design thinking, persona-based discovery, or workshop facilitation.

* Experience selling to SMB or in high-velocity, transactional sales motions.

* Experience mentoring or leading enablement for a team.

How We Work

* Builder mentality: we show up with working demos and real solutions, not just slides.

* Customer obsession: we go deep on customer problems before prescribing solutions.

* Peer teaching: we share what we learn, internally, with customers, and at industry events.

* Ownership: we see problems and fix them, and we share responsibility for the number.


Why Join Us

Salesforce Analytics is a key innovation driver in the agentic world, and it is as much a philosophy as a suite of tools. Operations

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

The Technical Analyst role is a part of the Quoting Rules team within the broader Product & Pricing Operations space. The work is fast-paced and broadly impactful across the company with various partner engagements. Responsibilities include helping craft scalable solutions and processes with engineers and architects, working with support teams who support customers and our internal systems, as well as taking business requirements to translate them into concrete technical requirements. To succeed, a candidate will need to be analytical, have excellent critical thinking skills, and be able to prioritize, deliver on multiple requests at once, identify inefficiencies in the process, and build scripts to help us continually improve.

This role is based in Hyderabad and follows PST working hours (5:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST).

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Design, implement, and manage the configuration of our internal CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) systems.
  • Implemented and have a deep understanding of Product Lifecycle Management along with Pricing Strategies.
  • Partners with stakeholders to capture product configuration requirements and drives their execution and ongoing support throughout the Product (SKU) Lifecycle Management process.
  • Fully accountable for the delivery of work assignments on time and to expectations in terms of quality, deliverables, and outcomes
  • Design and develop Automation frameworks to reduce human efforts and increase team efficiency.
  • Support the operation and maintenance of existing and future CPQ infrastructure, including rule configuration, release management, environment management, data transformation, and migration.
  • Lead all aspects of troubleshooting and bug fixing for published rules configurations and case management.
  • Own end-to-end governance of quoting rules, including impact analysis, UAT support, defect resolution, and continuous optimization of rule frameworks and production support
  • Enable faster NPI and product launches by building reusable quoting rule patterns and automation frameworks that reduce manual intervention and errors.
  • Should have done at least two end-to-end implementation of a CPQ project.
  • Identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and areas for improvement in the product lifecycle.
  • Influence partners, facilitate and steer group conversations and be clear with expectations and timelines.
  • Should possess a keen eye for identifying and automating manual tasks using scripting solutions.
  • This position follows PST working hours only (5:30 PM – 2:30 AM IST).
  • This is an Office based position out of the Hyderabad Office.



You're Our Person If...

  • Proficiency in Salesforce administration and SOQL.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ, Apttus CPQ, and Approvals.
  • Proficiency in using AI tools (e.g., generative AI assistants) to improve productivity, analysis, and problem-solving.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a customer-service mindset.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to explain technical issues clearly to executive leadership and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to manage workload with minimal supervision while prioritizing accuracy of deliverables.
  • Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of technical and administrative experience on Salesforce projects.
  • 1+ year of hands-on experience configuring a CPQ system.



Even Better If...

  • Experience with Python, Salesforce Agentforce, or other AI and automation scripting tools.



Technical Business Analyst (Shift: 5:30pm - 2:30am), Product & Pricing Ops - Hyderabad

Client Director – Tier 1 Pharma


Our team sells the full Salesforce product portfolio to Tier 1 pharmaceutical customers, partnering with some of the world's largest, most innovative and highly regulated pharmaceutical organisations.


As a Client Director at Salesforce, you will own the end-to-end strategic relationship with your assigned account. You will sell the entire Salesforce Customer 360 platform, including Agentforce, Data Cloud and Life Sciences Cloud, helping customers accelerate digital transformation, improve operational efficiency and deliver better outcomes for healthcare professionals and patients.

You will build trusted relationships with C-suite and senior business and technology leaders across the organisation, spanning commercial, medical affairs, R&D, clinical operations, manufacturing, supply chain and IT. You will connect Salesforce's capabilities to the customer's strategic priorities, positioning Salesforce as a long-term transformation partner.


What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Act as the executive owner of the Salesforce relationship, building and maintaining senior relationships across commercial, medical, R&D, clinical operations, manufacturing, technology, data, compliance and procurement functions.
  • Own and deliver a multi-year strategic account plan that grows Annual Contract Value (ACV) through expansion, upsell, cross-sell and new business within the account.
  • Map the organisation in depth, including key stakeholders, budgets, buying centres, strategic initiatives and whitespace across global business units and divisions.
  • Lead complex, multi-threaded sales cycles in parallel. Orchestrate Sales Engineers, Industry Advisors, Professional Services, Customer Success, Executives and Partners as one account team.
  • Position Salesforce as a strategic partner in the pharmaceutical company's digital, data and AI transformation agenda, connecting our solutions to measurable outcomes across customer engagement, commercial effectiveness, medical affairs, operational efficiency and patient experience.
  • Understand the pharmaceutical value chain and identify opportunities to support the organisation across the drug development lifecycle, from clinical development and regulatory processes through to commercialisation and ongoing patient engagement.
  • Navigate complex regulatory, security, data privacy, governance and procurement environments, building compelling business cases for large, multi-year strategic investments.
  • Work with global System Integrators and strategic partners to extend our reach, accelerate transformation and ensure customer success.
  • Partner with Customer Success to drive adoption, renewals, expansion and long-term customer advocacy.

You're Our Person If You Have...

  • A proven track record of quota-carrying, enterprise technology direct sales, ideally as a Client Director, Strategic AE or equivalent, with experience of single-account or named-account ownership.
  • Experience managing long, complex sales cycles with large deal values and multiple senior stakeholders.
  • Success developing and executing strategic account plans that retain and grow ACV.
  • The ability to navigate large, matrixed global organisations and build influence across multiple business units and geographies.
  • The ability to run discovery with senior leaders and translate business challenges into compelling use cases, value hypotheses and transformation opportunities.
  • Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills, with the credibility to engage at C-suite level.
  • Experience leading large virtual account teams across internal and external stakeholders.

Even Better If You Have...

  • Experience selling into Tier 1 pharmaceutical companies or global life sciences organisations.
  • A strong understanding of the pharmaceutical and life sciences landscape, including drug development, clinical trials, commercial operations, medical affairs, patient engagement and the evolving regulatory environment.
  • Familiarity with digital transformation within pharma, particularly around data strategy, AI adoption, customer engagement and operational modernisation.
  • Experience navigating complex pharmaceutical regulatory and compliance environments, including GxP, GDPR and patient data privacy considerations.
  • Familiarity with enterprise sales methodologies, such as MEDDICC, and experience building strategic alliances.
  • A history of consistently achieving or exceeding quota on large, strategic enterprise accounts.
  • An existing network of senior relationships within global pharmaceutical companies or across the UK/EMEA life sciences ecosystem.

About Real Estate and Workplace Services


The Real Estate and Workplace Services (REWS) organization designs, operates, and evolves the environments and experiences that enable Salesforce employees and customers to do their best work. Spanning more than 30 countries and customers to do their best work. Spanning more than 30 countries, our Agentic Campus reflects our values and culture – bringing together humans, agents, and robots to create inclusive, purpose-driven spaces where people feel a true sense of belonging. As customer zero of Salesforce's own technology, REWS is leading the way, creating innovative and dynamic spaces that provide seamless and inspiring workplace experiences.

Overview of the Role

The Real Estate Strategy and Planning team shapes how Salesforce's global office portfolio evolves: where we grow, where we consolidate, and how our footprint supports the business. As Senior Analyst, you will be the team's analytical engine. You'll turn portfolio, workforce, occupancy and market data into insights that drive metro and country portfolio strategies. Using AI tools and modern analytics platforms, you'll build dashboards, scenarios and interactive materials that help leaders make faster, better-informed real estate decisions. You'll partner closely with Strategic Finance, Transactions, Business Partners and other REWS teams.

Core Responsibilities & Scope

  • Data analysis: Analyze portfolio, lease, headcount, hiring forecast, occupancy and utilization data to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
  • Metro strategy: Build the fact base for key metros (footprint, demand forecasts, utilization, lease expirations and market conditions) and help develop options to consolidate, expand, relocate or hold.
  • Country portfolio strategy: Support country-level strategies with footprint benchmarks, cost and occupancy profiles, and long-range planning inputs.
  • Supply and demand planning: Model real estate supply vs. demand, track critical dates and space requirements, and flag gaps or surplus early.
  • Scenario analysis: Build and run portfolio scenarios, and provide data inputs to Strategic Finance for financial modeling and to Transactions for deal planning.
  • Dashboards and metrics: Build and maintain dashboards and interactive tools covering portfolio KPIs (cost per seat, cost per sq ft, utilization, occupancy), making sure metrics fit the reporting objective.
  • AI-enabled analysis: Use AI tools and platforms to automate data analysis, surface occupancy and utilization trends faster, and speed up scenario and presentation work.
  • Market intelligence: Use third-party real estate and occupancy data platforms to gather market, benchmark and competitive insights.
  • Presentation materials: Turn analysis into clear, exec-ready decks, summaries and interactive materials, and support project approval requests with proper documentation.
  • Ad-hoc decision support: Respond quickly and accurately to analysis requests from leadership and partners.



Minimum Requirements

  • 3–5 years of experience in real estate strategy, analytics, consulting, FP&A or a related field
  • Strong analytical and data skills, including advanced Excel and hands-on use of BI and AI tools to automate analysis and build dashboards
  • Experience supporting scenario analysis and business modeling for strategic decisions
  • Strong PowerPoint and storytelling skills, and the ability to turn data into a clear point of view for senior audiences
  • High attention to detail, organization and data accuracy while managing competing priorities
  • Proactive self-starter who adapts to shifting priorities and works well across teams
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Real Estate, Data Analytics or related field



Preferred Qualifications

  • Corporate real estate or workplace planning experience (leases, occupancy, space and headcount planning)
  • Experience with third-party real estate and occupancy data platforms (e.g., CoStar, Serraview, utilization and badge analytics tools)
  • SQL or other data tools, and experience building interactive or AI-powered tools
  • Experience with multi-country or global portfolios
  • Familiarity with Salesforce products such as Tableau and Slack



In this role, you'll gain broad exposure to global portfolio strategy, executive decision-making and the use of AI in corporate real estate planning.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters

Salesforce AI Research is a global leader in Enterprise AI, driving innovations that advance the state of AI while powering enterprise products at worldwide scale. We take ideas from research to real-world impact, working closely with product teams and enterprise customers to translate cutting-edge research into production AI capabilities used by millions of users. Learn more at Salesforce AI Research.

Within AI Research, our Incubation team bridges our foundational technology and our customers' needs. We meet with customers to understand their biggest pain points, connect them to emerging technologies from our researchers' work, and validate those technologies with real users to inform our future products.

We sit at the intersection of research and product innovation, combining AI research and applied AI to turn foundational innovation into real solutions for real customers. We are looking for a Summer 2027 intern to help us validate and shape what we build next.

Core Responsibilities & Scope


  • Design user research plans to help validate pilots and experiments
  • Conduct discovery interviews and synthesize learnings
  • Produce reports of user studies and their outcome
  • Make recommendations for pilot direction and future experiments
  • Establish standardized research protocols, templates, and assessment frameworks for unified user evaluations
  • Collaborate with researchers, engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate research findings into recommendations for product development.



Minimum Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a graduate degree in a relevant field, such as Human-Computer Interaction, Information Science, Business, Economics, Psychology, or a related discipline.
  • Experience conducting qualitative or quantitative research, including interviews, surveys, or experimental studies.
  • Ability to analyze and synthesize research findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings to technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Interest in artificial intelligence, emerging technologies, and understanding how people interact with technology.



Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience conducting user research, usability testing, or customer discovery for software or AI-powered applications.
  • Familiarity with research methods such as experimental design, A/B testing, longitudinal studies, or adoption analysis.
  • Experience working with qualitative and quantitative research tools, including Excel, SQL, Python, R, or survey platforms.
  • Understanding of product incubation, technology adoption, and business impact measurement.
  • Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams or conducting research in an industry setting.
  • Ability to vibe-code tools that help in the synthesis and collection of data at scale.

This role encompasses architecture, design, implementation, and testing to ensure we build products right and release them with high quality. The successful candidate will have:

  • Develop scalable frontend components and systems using modern web standards (HTML5, ES6+, CSS3) and component-based architectures

  • Present and defend technical designs to stakeholders and provide constructive feedback on others' architectural proposals

  • Strong React experience (Angular, Vue, Ember also considered)
  • Modern build toolchain expertise - Vite, Webpack, Rollup, esbuild, npm/Yarn
  • Mobile-first responsive design and cross-browser compatibility experience
  • Web performance optimization and security best practices knowledge
  • Component architecture understanding - MVC patterns, design systems, web components
  • Testing expertise - Test Driven Development, Jest, Playwright, Cucumber, and frontend testing methodologies
  • Strong communication skills for technical documentation and cross-team collaboration
  • A related technical degree required


Even Better If...

  • Design system experience - building and scaling component libraries from scratch
  • Identity and authentication systems experience - OAuth, SAML, SSO, user management, security protocols

The position is based in Mexico City and provides support globally alongside the Indian SSC team.

  • Manage daily queue operations, including quote approvals and contract modification cases

  • Engage with external auditors and understand and respond to changes in the audit approach
  • Establish standard contract structures for existing and new products, and work cross-functionally to maintain a scalable quote-to-cash process
  • Lead training on revenue recognition rules, policies, and practices within the Company, particularly within the Sales organization

  • 5+ years of relevant revenue recognition experience
  • Verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present ideas clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical audiences as well as senior executives
  • Fluent Spanish and English
  • Project management skills, including planning, task assignment, status tracking, and reporting

Preferred Qualifications

  • Primary audit and ASC 606 experience in the SaaS, software, or tech industry
  • A blend of public accounting and industry experience
  • Experience in SOX control documentation and execution
  • Team player who works well with virtual, global, and cross-functional teams while championing diversity of team, thought, and opinion

  • Identify the highest-impact barriers to Fin’s growth and proactively drive them to resolution across Salesforce.
