Our Canada Architecture team works on Salesforce’s largest and most complex customers across Canada’s many industries. We don’t stop at showing customers what’s possible; we prove it by building it with them. Success here is a working prototype or a deployed asset, not a great deck.

As a Principal or Distinguished Applied AI Architect, you will be the trusted technical lead for a set of strategic accounts. You’ll help design agentic AI architectures that hold up under real scrutiny: governed multi-agent systems, headless and API-first experiences, and unified data and integration patterns that span Agentforce, Data 360, MuleSoft, and the customer’s existing systems. You’ll work across the full engagement. That means framing the problem with C-level and Chief Architect stakeholders, building the prototype that proves the value, and handing it off cleanly to partners and delivery teams so it scales into production and becomes a reusable play for the whole organization.

You’ll sit within the Canada architecture team and belong to the broader Regulated Industries & Canada architecture community. That gives you exposure to patterns and peers within the unregulated industries within Canada, and also the regulated industries across financial services, healthcare, and life sciences.


What you’ll do

Lead agentic AI architecture on strategic accounts. Serve as the aligned architect for your accounts. Run discovery and org assessments, set the current- and future-state architecture, and own architectural direction from first conversation through production handoff. Shape decisions on agent orchestration, MCP and agent-to-agent interoperability, headless and composable design, data foundations, and the trust and governance layer.

Build to prove value. Co-build working prototypes and proof-of-value assets on customers’ own data and objects, using modern AI-assisted development tools. Turn a hypothesis into something a business sponsor can see and use within weeks, not quarters.

Run and extend our engagement plays. Deliver our defined engagement models. These cover the economics of an agentic operating model, headless experiences that keep governance intact, governed multi-agent systems at enterprise scale, and executive North Star architecture. Add new content and reusable components back to the shared library, so each engagement leaves the next one further ahead.

Own the handoff and the path to scale. Package architecture, data dictionaries, process maps, and agent metadata so that partners, SIs, and delivery teams can take the work to production without losing the design intent. Hold clear entry and exit gates so delivery stays planned and predictable.

Advise executives on business outcomes. Translate architecture into business value for CIOs, CTOs, Chief Architects, and line-of-business leaders. Fit designs to industry relevant and country specific regulatory, data residency, model risk, and operating-model constraints. Represent Salesforce at executive briefings, architecture review boards, and industry events.

Elevate the team and the field. Mentor architects and account teams. Contribute points of view, reference architectures, and reusable assets. Work closely with AEs, SEs, Professional Services, forward-deployed engineers, partners, and product teams, with each role doing its own job well.

  • Architecture-sourced pipeline and measurable progression on priority opportunities in your accounts.
  • Agentforce and Data 360 consumption milestones reached and tied to customer outcomes.
  • Prototypes that convert into production commitments and reusable plays adopted by other architects.
  • Customers who treat you as their go-to architecture advisor, shown by repeat engagement and sponsorship from executive and Chief Architect stakeholders.
  • Disciplined engagement records, so your impact is visible and credited.

What you’ll bring

  • Bilingual French & English to support relevant Canada regions.
  • 10+ years in enterprise or solution architecture, including significant customer-facing work with knowledge of B2B and B2C business patterns.
  • Deep hands-on experience with the Salesforce platform and enterprise integration, ideally MuleSoft and API-led design.
  • Practical, current experience designing and building AI solutions. This includes LLM-based agents, retrieval and grounding, agent orchestration, and emerging interoperability standards such as MCP and A2A.
  • Builder credibility. You personally prototype using code and/or AI-assisted development tools, and you’re comfortable working in Git-based workflows.
  • Working knowledge of regulatory and risk requirements: privacy, data residency, model risk management, auditability, and AI governance. You also know how these requirements shape architecture decisions.
  • Executive presence. You can hold a contested architecture debate with a Chief Architect and move it to a decision.
  • A team-first operating style. You’re comfortable working within aligned coverage, sharing assets, and making others better.

Major Canadian Industries Served

Our engagements cross Canada’s major industry sectors, focusing on manufacturing, automotive, energy, transportation, retail, consumer goods, hospitality, telecommunications, media, healthcare, life sciences, professional services, technology, and oil & gas.

  • Salesforce certifications such as Agentforce Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, Application/System Architect, or progress toward CTA.

What is a Solution Engineer?
Also known as a " Pre -Sales Engineer" or "Sales Consultant," the Solution Engineer is responsible for presenting product offerings and architecture in the best light to prospects and customers, to evoke confidence in the company's technology infrastructure, and to remove all technical objections in the sales cycle. To accomplish this, the Solution Engineer must have a strong desire to leverage their technical and/or sales skills, including the ability to solicit business requirements, develop a technical sales strategy, configure and effectively demonstrate the solutions that address these requirements and provide business value.

Lead, Specialist Solution Engineer
Are you a seasoned analytics expert who loves turning complex data challenges into clear, compelling solutions? As a Lead Solution Engineer, Analytics at Salesforce, you'll go beyond traditional pre-sales: you'll lead the technical strategy on your most strategic opportunities and help customers build a trusted, governed semantic foundation for their analytics. You'll be a recognized technical authority on Tableau's semantic layer and analytics interoperability, and a trusted advisor to business and technical stakeholders across LATAM.

What You'll Be Doing
The Lead Specialist Solution Engineer leads the technical sales cycle for Analytics on complex opportunities, from vision co-creation through storytelling demos to deep-dive workshops, showing customers the "why" and the "what." You'll run deep discovery on business and data needs, then design and demo semantic models that define metrics, dimensions, and business rules once and make them reusable and governed across the organization. You'll position Tableau Semantics and Tableau Next alongside Tableau Cloud and Server, and show how analytics interoperability and Tableau Knowledge help customers unify their data context across platforms. You'll partner with Account Executives to recommend solutions with measurable ROI, and share best practices with peers through demos and discovery coaching. Ideal candidates have experience with Tableau, CRM Analytics, the Salesforce core platform, Data 360 / data integration, semantic modeling, and BI in a customer-facing role.

Your Impact

  • Build trusted advisor relationships with business and technical stakeholders by:
    • Understanding their business challenges and data/analytics strategy
    • Identifying the best Tableau solution for their needs
    • Supporting them in achieving their business goals
  • Help customers become more data-driven by showcasing Tableau and building excitement around the platform
  • Lead discovery sessions and workshops with business users to define, build, and implement solution prototypes
  • Design and demo semantic models (Tableau Semantics, Published Data Sources) that define metrics and business rules once, with governance, for reuse across the organization
  • Build and present customized demos that prove business value, including analytics interoperability across Tableau Cloud, Server, Tableau Next, and CRM Analytics
  • Position recent Tableau innovations (Tableau Next, Tableau Semantics, Tableau Knowledge) and explain how they fit with the customer's existing data stack
  • Articulate the business value of Tableau to managers and business leaders
  • Deliver technical responses on RFPs/RFIs
  • Support adjacent teams in positioning Tableau and Salesforce's analytics portfolio
  • Handle multiple customer engagements at once across LATAM, prioritizing with the sales team
  • Share customer feedback with the product GTM team and contribute to analytics thought leadership across LATAM
  • Share best practices with peers through demos and knowledge sharing



What we're looking for

We're seeking a proactive professional with solid presales or technical expertise gained in the software/IT industry or as an end user. Ideally, you bring broad technical knowledge plus specialized expertise in one or more of these areas: data visualization/analytics, BI, semantic modeling, data quality, integration, databases, or analytics infrastructure.

  • Experienced: Proven ability to build trust with customers and navigate the sales cycle, with 3+ years in technical pre-sales or consulting and a B.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS or equivalent
  • Technically strong: Hands-on experience in one or more of the areas above. Python and/or JavaScript is a plus. Experience analyzing data, identifying trends, and building visualizations
  • Specialized knowledge: Experience building and delivering PoCs and answering the technical and functional parts of RFIs/RFPs. Familiarity with Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar tools. Experience with data modeling, semantic layers, star schema design, and data warehouse concepts

Salesforce’s Global Consulting Partner (GCP) organization is seeking a Director, Partner Account Management to run our Accenture Edge (NeuraFlash) business globally across all industries. This role is for someone who makes sound calls quickly and builds systems to promote a scaling partnership.

Accenture Edge is Accenture’s mid-market business, acquired in 2026 to help companies with $300M–$3B in annual revenue harness AI and reinvent how they operate. For Salesforce, it is a scalable route to bring Agentforce and Data 360 to mid-market customers worldwide. Accenture is also one of our largest strategic consulting partners and a Founding Partner of Salesforce’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) Partner Network.

What You’ll Do:

Make the daily calls on where to lean in and where to stop: which segments, industries, regions, and accounts get joint attention, and which do not.

Allocate and reallocate joint investment (funds, programs, resources) based on measured return, and retire what is not working.

Resolve escalations on deals, delivery, and the relationship quickly, then fix the underlying process so the same issue does not recur.

Weigh competing priorities across Sales, Partner Sales, regional PAMs, and Accenture, and make tradeoffs transparent.

Work with Accenture to build certified Agentforce and Data 360 delivery capacity ahead of demand, in line with the FDE Partner Network.

Use automation, data, and AI to run the partnership with less manual effort and fewer handoffs.

Manage the partnership by signal, not anecdote: partner-influenced pipeline and revenue, certified practitioner growth (including Agentforce), consumption, and customer outcomes and references.

Spot early indicators of risk or momentum, and act before they show up in the forecast.

Translate performance into clear, concise narratives for Salesforce and Accenture executives.

Serve as the primary Salesforce counterpart to Accenture Edge leadership, building trust at the C-suite and VP level.

Align Sales, Partner Sales, Partner Success, regional and industry PAMs, Marketing, Legal, and Operations around one coordinated approach to Edge.

Bring field and customer signals back into Salesforce product, program, and partner strategy decisions.

10+ years in partnerships, sales, or consulting, with a track record of driving partner revenue and exceeding targets.

Proven success running strategic, global relationships with consulting organizations or SIs. Accenture experience is strongly preferred.

Experience building scaled, repeatable co-sell motions, ideally including mid-market.

Deep understanding of co-sell mechanics and partner investment programs, and how to measure their return.

Strong judgment under ambiguity: you make clear, well-reasoned decisions with incomplete information, explain your reasoning, and know when to escalate.

Comfort with complexity, and the ability to think at multiple levels of abstraction.

Executive presence, with the ability to build trust and influence at the C-suite and VP level. You lead through influence in a matrixed global organization.

Strong command of Salesforce technology, including platform, SaaS, Agentforce, and Data 360.

As AI gets better at building things, the bottleneck shifts to knowing what to build. We're the bridge between AI systems and what humans actually want. Today our customers are companies. Soon, AIs themselves will be our customers.

Our platform runs AI-moderated video interviews at massive scale. We find the right people from a network of millions, our AI conducts open-ended conversations with thousands of them in parallel, and we surface what to build next. What used to take research teams weeks per study, we do in hours.

Where it's going: every interview feeds a human preference model. We simulate human behavior at scale: how people react to new ideas, how they make decisions, how preferences shape markets, and how change ripples through society. We expose this as the Human API. An AI agent writes code, asks Listen whether users would actually want a feature, gets a grounded answer back, and iterates. Closed-loop product development at AI speed. Every coding agent will eventually need this signal.

Listen was acquired by Salesforce in 2026 and is being incubated within Salesforce AI Labs!

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Company Highlights

  • World-Class Team: Founded by serial entrepreneurs — Alfred (Bemlo, YC W22) and Florian (IOI medalist, ICPC World Finalist) — and built with talent from Google, Meta, Tesla, Amazon, Jane Street, and X, alongside Bain, Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, and Sequoia-backed startups like Applied Intuition, Scale AI, and Rippling. Over 30% of our team are former founders, and multiple are competitive programming medalists.
  • Hypergrowth: Since launching, Listen has grown annualized revenue 15x and completed over 2 million interviews — backed by $100M in total funding led by Ribbit Capital, with Sequoia, Conviction, and Pear VC participating.
  • Traction: Already serving 15% of Fortune 100s. Enterprise wins and expansions across Anthropic, Microsoft, Nestlé, Perplexity, Sweetgreen, and more — with teams telling us research that used to take six to eight weeks now happens in days.

What You'll Do

  • Database of Humanity. Listen maintains a database of millions of people. We match profiles based on voice, face, and device IDs. Those profiles let us see how opinions change over time, prevent fraud, and find any niche audience.
  • Emotional Intelligence. There's a gap between what people say and what they think. Our AI interviewer reads tone, hesitation, and facial micro-expressions to go beyond the transcript. We've shipped the first version. We're working on surpassing even the best humans.
  • Preference Model. Updating the preference model is a research problem: what we already know, when to refresh it, which questions give the highest signal, and how to quantify the uncertainty in our predictions.
  • Human API. A model of millions of humans is only useful if you can call it from where decisions happen. We want to embed this into Slack, Linear, IDEs, and coding agents themselves. Imagine an agent shipping code, asking Listen what humans actually want, taking action, and iterating.
  • Agent Evals. Every part of our product is built AI-first. Study Composer helps customers scope and design studies. Research Agent analyzes thousands of responses and writes the report. The ceiling is what McKinsey does for $1M per engagement. The bottleneck is evaluating those qualitative outputs. Once you have the eval, you can hill-climb.

  • You solve problems end to end. The team is split vertically, so every engineer owns a part of the product and makes decisions across the LLM pipeline, infrastructure, backend, and UX.

  • AI Development (Bonus): If you have experience in AI, you may have the opportunity to contribute to projects involving AI-powered accessibility features.

  • Design Skills: An eye for good design and an understanding of user experience principles.

Design and build the proof. Develop the playbook.


Salesforce is hiring technically grounded Slack AI Solution Strategists—storytellers and designers who make the art of the possible tangible. You will partner with Salesforce leaders through Customer Zero engagements.


Working hands-on from discovery and experience design through prototyping and validation, you will build working proofs that demonstrate technical feasibility and business value. This role does not own full customer implementations, long-term production engineering, or ongoing solution support.


Key Responsibilities


  • Targeted Engagement Ownership: Lead focused engagements from business and technical discovery through solution design, configuration, integration planning, validation, enablement, and handoff.

  • Product and Engineering Feedback Loop: Capture high-value use cases, user evidence, AI behavior, technical constraints, and product gaps; synthesize recurring patterns; and partner with Product and Engineering to inform product direction and future capabilities.

When a solution is not working as intended, investigate the underlying cause and distinguish among configuration, data, integration, product capability, AI behavior, and adoption issues.
  • Value Demonstration and Storytelling: Communicate the vision, working experience, technical tradeoffs, and potential business value through compelling narratives and demonstrations.
  • Strategic Use Case Workshops: Partner with account teams across OUs on use case workshops and connect the dots between Product and feedback from the field.
  • Playbook Development: Turn engagement learnings into reusable solution patterns, stories, and playbooks for leaders, sellers, and customers.

  • 5-7 years of experience in Solutions Engineering, technical consulting, solution implementation, solution architecture, technical product delivery, or another customer-facing delivery role.

  • Strong working knowledge of Slack, including its workflows, integrations, administration, security, and evolving AI capabilities.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce and Tableau and how enterprise teams use these platforms to access data, insights, and business workflows
  • Practical understanding of applied AI and agentic systems, including prompting, grounding, retrieval, tool use, evaluation, guardrails, and common failure modes.
  • Understanding of the product lifecycle and experience working through discovery, design, configuration, testing, release, adoption, and feedback.
  • Working knowledge of APIs, MCP, integration patterns, identity, data access, permission models, and enterprise security.
  • Executive presence and the ability to communicate technical concepts, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to senior business and technical leaders.
  • Ability to synthesize individual engagement learnings into reusable patterns, stories, and guidance.
  • Passion for Slack, applied AI, agentic technology, and the future of work.
  • You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside internal leaders and/or customers.

Even better if You have:


  • Hands-on experience designing or configuring AI assistants, agents, prompts, skills, workflows, or automations.
  • Familiarity with SQL to help accurately create and review data-related Slackbot prompts
  • Experience with technical or solution architecture, particularly across enterprise SaaS platforms.
  • Experience with Salesforce CRM, Data Cloud, Agentforce, Tableau, or related Salesforce technologies.
  • Salesforce, Slack, Tableau, architecture, or comparable Platform or Admin Certifications.
  • Experience working with sales leaders, sellers, Sales Operations, or revenue organizations.

How You Think and Work


  • A Storyteller: You turn complex technology and business needs into a clear, compelling vision that helps people see what is possible and why it matters.
  • A Designer: You begin with people and workflows, shaping intuitive experiences that solve meaningful problems.
  • Technically Grounded: You understand how systems, data, integrations, permissions, and AI behavior interact and can build credible proofs without needing to own production engineering.
  • A Strategic Builder: You move fluidly from discovery and business value through design, configuration, prototyping, and validation.

  • Iterative: You build useful proof, test it with real users, and improve it based on evidence.
  • Metacognitive: You examine your assumptions and reasoning, assess the quality of AI outputs, seek feedback, and adjust your approach as you learn.

Named Account Executive – Justice & Public Safety

State & Local Government | Multi-State Territory


About the Role

Salesforce is expanding its investment in Justice & Public Safety (JPS), and we are seeking a motivated, entrepreneurial Account Executive to help establish and grow our presence across a multi-state territory.

This is a new business development (“hunter”) role focused on building relationships, developing market opportunities, and helping courts, law enforcement agencies, and other justice and public safety organizations modernize the way they operate and serve their communities.

We are looking for someone who understands the unique challenges facing justice and public safety organizations and can translate that understanding into meaningful technology solutions. The ideal candidate may be an experienced technology seller with an established network in the JPS market or a former justice and public safety professional with deep operational knowledge, strong relationships, and an interest in transitioning into technology sales.

The Justice & Public Safety technology market is ready for a new generation of solutions. For decades, many agencies have relied on rigid, legacy case management systems from a relatively small group of entrenched vendors. These systems often limit flexibility, create fragmented information environments, and require agencies to adapt their operations to the constraints of their technology.

Salesforce is bringing an entirely different level of technological capability to this market. Built on a modern enterprise cloud platform, our solutions offer truly configurable workflows, connected data, intelligent automation, advanced analytics, and modern user experiences that represent a significant departure from traditional justice and public safety software.

This is an opportunity to help introduce a new technology alternative to a market that has historically had limited choices. Our expanding portfolio includes established Salesforce capabilities such as MuleSoft, Tableau, Slack, and the Salesforce Platform, alongside emerging court and justice case management solutions.


Key Responsibilities:

Territory Development & Business Growth

  • Develop and execute a strategic business development plan across an assigned multi-state territory, with an emphasis on creating new opportunities and establishing Salesforce’s presence in the JPS market.
  • Identify and prioritize courts, law enforcement agencies, sheriff’s offices, prosecutors, public defenders, corrections organizations, and other justice and public safety entities with meaningful purchasing authority and modernization needs.
  • Build a sustainable pipeline through proactive outreach, industry relationships, referrals, conferences, and targeted engagement with agency leadership.
  • Develop relationships with key stakeholders, including judges, court administrators, elected officials, sheriffs, police chiefs, prosecutors, CIOs, and government executives.
  • Navigate complex government procurement, budgeting, funding, and decision-making processes.



Industry Expertise & Consultative Selling

  • Develop a strong understanding of agency operations, existing technology environments, operational challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Engage customers in conversations about business outcomes rather than simply presenting software features.
  • Help agencies envision how modern technology can reduce manual work, improve coordination, connect information across departments, and enhance public service delivery.
  • Identify opportunities to deliver immediate value through Salesforce’s established capabilities, including MuleSoft, Tableau, Slack, and the Salesforce Platform, while cultivating longer-term opportunities for broader transformation.
  • Understand the competitive landscape, including established court, law enforcement, and public safety technology providers, and effectively articulate Salesforce’s differentiated approach.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor by connecting technology capabilities to the practical realities of government operations.



Collaboration & Market Development

  • Partner closely with Salesforce solution engineers, industry specialists, product teams, implementation partners, and leadership to develop compelling customer solutions.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce’s Justice & Public Safety strategy and product teams to share market feedback, identify emerging requirements, and help shape future opportunities.
  • Coordinate customer discovery sessions, operational assessments, demonstrations, and executive presentations.
  • Contribute to the development of repeatable sales approaches, industry use cases, customer success stories, and go-to-market strategies.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline, account planning, and forecast information while managing opportunities from initial engagement through contract execution.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience in enterprise technology sales, justice and public safety operations, government leadership, or a combination of these disciplines.
  • Strong understanding of the justice and public safety market, including agency operations, organizational structures, stakeholders, and purchasing considerations.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish relationships, influence decision-makers, identify opportunities, and communicate compelling business value.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a willingness to develop a territory, prospect into new organizations, and build opportunities where no established sales pipeline exists.
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across technical, industry, sales, and executive teams.
  • Comfort navigating long, complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Ability to travel regularly within the assigned territory.
  • Residence within the assigned territory required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7–10+ years of relevant professional experience, including enterprise software sales, public sector business development, or operational leadership in justice and public safety.
  • Proven success selling technology solutions to state or local government agencies, particularly courts, law enforcement, corrections, or related justice organizations.
  • Established professional relationships within the justice and public safety community.
  • Experience with court case management systems, law enforcement technology, records management, data integration, analytics, or government modernization initiatives.
  • Prior experience at a justice and public safety technology provider, such as Tyler Technologies, or another organization serving this market.
  • Alternatively, previous professional experience as a court administrator, judge, prosecutor, law enforcement officer, corrections leader, or other justice and public safety professional with strong business development aptitude.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, enterprise SaaS platforms, government procurement, and public sector technology implementation.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role requires more than managing existing customer relationships. The successful candidate will establish credibility within the justice and public safety community, build a network of trusted agency relationships, identify meaningful opportunities for modernization, and create a sustainable pipeline for Salesforce’s growing JPS business.

We are looking for someone who is excited about helping Salesforce challenge the status quo in a market ready for a new generation of technology—someone who sees the opportunity to build a business while introducing courts and public safety agencies to capabilities and possibilities that traditional systems have struggled to deliver.

What You’ll Be Doing & Why It Matters

The Office of Ethical and Humane Use (OEHU) was formed with a mandate to ensure that Salesforce technology is used to help, not harm, society and uphold the basic human rights of every human being. The Slack Policy team within OEHU plays a pivotal role in advancing, implementing, and enforcing policy on the Slack platform. We safeguard the conversations that power the world’s work.

As a member of the Slack Policy Operations team, you will support day-to-day policy enforcement operations, including reviewing customer reports and escalations related to safety, security, and potential ethical use policy violations. This role will also involve responding to internal inquiries, conducting research and investigations, and partnering closely with Slack’s Security, Legal, and Product teams. You will solve complex customer issues, mentor (and be mentored by) team members, and lead initiatives that continuously improve the customer experience and drive impact through collaboration across Slack. This role requires content moderation escalation responsibility, including regular exposure to potentially harmful content such as images of violence, hate speech, or content that exploits or endangers children. Comfort and experience with trust and safety operations or content moderation is essential. We’re committed to giving you the opportunity to do the best work of your life, while helping others do the same.

Core Responsibilities & Scope

  • Handle complex customer reports of potentially harmful and illegal content balancing speed and thoroughness to meet legal obligations while ensuring high-quality decision making.
  • Investigate abuse reports and potential acceptable use policy violations objectively and without personal bias.
  • Support confidential workspace ownership transfer requests by verifying data ownership, assessing legal and contractual obligations, and evaluating risks related to access, control, and the transfer of customer data
  • Respond to internal inquiries and conduct research and investigations.
  • Partner closely with Slack’s Security, Legal, and Product, and Customer Experience teams on escalated cases.

  • Identify and surface customer issues and policy trends, helping to implement process improvements in collaboration with relevant teams across Slack.

descriptionHtml:

About Salesforce

About the team

Our security team supports the unwritten fourth tenet of Slack’s mission: make people’s working lives more secure. We are passionate about protecting our infrastructure, operations, and most importantly, our customers’ data. We take a thoughtful approach to security and strive to provide a low friction, high-impact security model across everything we do.


Slack Security Operations (SecOps) is a small, engineering-led team covering the US and ANZ. We run detection and response for Slack's production infrastructure, with on-call around the clock. Unlike a traditional CSIRT, the team is made up of software engineers who specialize in security. We also build and run core infrastructure and identity services deeply embedded in how Slack works: including network encryption, identity tools, secrets management, logging pipelines and alerting. 


We work in a lean, high-ownership, startup-style way, with heavy cross-functional collaboration. Slack's incident response is open and culture-driven: engineers across the company join in to solve problems together, and SecOps is at the center of it for anything security-related. We're also leaning hard into AI agents for continuous monitoring, triage and response. 


About the role

We are looking for a staff level blue team software engineer to help drive our threat detection and response efforts and to collaborate on our development efforts. An interest in development, operations, curiosity, and a deep desire to learn are key to a successful member of the team.

As a Staff Security Engineer, you'll be a senior technical leader for the team. You'll play an active role in setting direction across detection and response, security infrastructure, and the secure adoption of AI agents. You'll still be hands-on: writing code (Go/Python), leading incidents, and owning hard problems from start to finish. Your impact will be measured by how much safer, more resilient and more scalable Slack becomes. 


This posting is to grow our US-based, widely distributed SecOps contingent, which works closely with our additional Melbourne & Auckland team. We’re eager to communicate and collaborate often (over Slack, of course!). You’ll join the rest of the team in our on-call rotation, and we also strongly look for you to grow your engineering participation at Slack more broadly!

Slack has a positive, diverse, and supportive culture—we look for people who are curious, inventive, and work to be a little better every single day. In our work together we aim to be smart, humble, hardworking, and above all, collaborative. If this sounds like a good fit for you, why not say “hello?”


Location: Remote (US). This role is open to candidates looking to work remotely from anywhere in the US.


What You Will Actually Be Doing:

  • Design, build, and operate security tools and infrastructure protecting Slack’s production environments at scale.
  • Serve as a senior incident lead and Major Incident Commander for high-severity threats, conducting blameless post-mortems for lasting remediation.
  • Enhance detection fidelity and signal quality by reducing noise, boosting true-positive rates, and automating recurring triage processes.
  • Establish security architecture and guardrails for AI agents, including least-privilege identities, cloud roles, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Develop reliable, auditable, and automated monitoring and threat-hunting capabilities for continuous detection.
  • Conduct security infrastructure reviews and advise engineering teams on secure design best practices.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation to maintain service health and respond to emerging security incidents.
  • Advise leadership on SecOps strategy, build vs. buy decisions, and roadmap scaling for the team.

You're Our Person If:


  • You possess U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residency. We're unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role.
  • 12+ years of security & infrastructure engineering experience, with a track record of building, operating, and owning production systems at scale.
  • Strong production software development skills in Go, Python, or Rust, beyond simple scripting.
  • Deep hands-on cloud incident response experience, including leading high-severity incidents, log forensics, and executive/technical communication.
  • Core infrastructure, identity & security expertise: Linux internals, networking/proxies, AWS IAM/guardrails, PKI, secrets management, and AuthN/AuthZ.
  • Automation, IaC & detection engineering: Terraform, Ansible, Chef, safe deployment practices, and log pipelines (Kafka, OpenSearch, ElastAlert).
  • AI/LLM security & agent safeguards: Prompt-injection defense, agent identity/permissions, and continuous monitoring of model invocations.
  • Staff-level technical leadership & communication: Writing proposals, driving async consensus, and prioritizing high-impact outcomes.
  • Regulated environments exposure: Experience with FedRAMP, GovCloud, or FIPS compliance standards.

Slack is where work happens. It connects you with the people and apps you work with every day, no matter where you are or what you do. We believe everyone deserves to work in a welcoming, respectful, and empathetic culture. We live by our values and hire accordingly. 


Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where we learn from each other is core to Slack's values. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and a fun place to work. Come do the best work of your life here at Slack.

我們認為「讓世界變得更好，才是商業的本質」。
Inside Sales 是為各行各業的客戶創造轉型契機的組織。

此職位負責台灣市場，向台灣企業提案 Salesforce 解決方案。您將與日本國內團隊合作，帶領台灣市場的開拓。

您需要了解台灣的市場特性，透過電話與電子郵件接觸高階主管及決策者，了解其經營課題與業務需求。
在此基礎上，主要工作是創造新的商機並建立銷售管道（Pipeline）。
不只是爭取預約會議，更期待您透過策略性的銷售活動，為業務成長做出貢獻。

此外，您需要熟悉台灣的商業習慣與商業文化，在理解台日商業環境差異的同時，與當地客戶建立信賴關係。本職位適合具備文化適應力與彈性，能在不同商業風格之間順暢溝通的人才。

您不僅會與台灣以及日本的銷售團隊合作，也會與 APAC 的 SDR、BDR 團隊協作。期待您與各國團隊攜手合作，將台灣市場的商業機會最大化。

You're Our Person If...

  • 具備 2～4 年以上無形商品的法人業務經驗
  • 具備達成目標的強烈企圖心
  • 具備任何形式的領導經驗
  • 強烈希望以 IT 業務作為職涯發展方向
  • 母語程度的中文能力
  • 具備台灣市場的商業經驗，或對台灣市場有所了解


Even Better If...

  • 具備與經營者層級洽談的經驗
  • 具備使用 CRM 的經驗
  • 自我成長意願高
  • 能以開放且積極的態度溝通
  • 具備商務英文能力以及能用英文內部溝通


【職涯發展】
本部門除了開發新案件之外，還肩負「培育未來頂尖業務」的重要任務。
Inside Sales 的員工中，新鮮人在進入公司第 3 年內者，以及許多中途加入者，原本都沒有 IT 產業經驗。透過公司引以為傲的培訓計畫，您將學習願景銷售（Vision Selling）與 IT 法人業務的基礎知識，並以成為客戶經理型業務（Account Sales，外勤業務）為目標。

金融、人力仲介、網路廣告、網際網路、顧問諮詢、製造業等

We believe that "making the world a better place is the essence of business."
Inside Sales is the organization that sparks transformation for customers across every industry and sector.

In this role, you will cover the Taiwan market and propose Salesforce solutions to Taiwanese companies. Working with teams in Japan, you will lead the development of the Taiwan market.

You will understand the characteristics of the Taiwan market, approach executives and decision-makers by phone and email, and learn about their management challenges and business needs.
Based on that, your main work is to create new business opportunities and build pipeline.
Beyond simply booking appointments, you will contribute to business growth through strategic sales activities.

You will also need to be well versed in Taiwan's business practices and culture, understand the differences between the Taiwanese and Japanese business environments, and build trust with local customers. This role suits people with cultural adaptability and flexibility who can communicate smoothly across different business styles.

You will work not only with the Japan team but also with the APAC SDR and BDR teams. You are expected to collaborate with teams in each country to maximize business opportunities in the Taiwan market.

  • 2–4+ years of B2B sales experience with intangible products
  • Drive to achieve targets
  • Some experience as a leader
  • A strong desire to build a career in IT sales
  • native Chinese
  • Business experience in, or an understanding of, the Taiwan market


Even Better If...

  • Experience negotiating with executive-level counterparts
  • Experience using a CRM
  • A strong drive for self-growth
  • Open and proactive communication
  • Business English skills

In addition to finding new deals, our department plays an important role in "developing future top salespeople."
Among Inside Sales employees, those within 3 years of joining as new graduates and many mid-career hires have no prior IT industry experience. Through our proud training program, you will learn vision selling and the fundamentals of IT B2B sales, while aiming to become an Account Sales (field sales) representative.

  • ES governance & single source of truth: Own the ES integration cadence, status reporting, and executive dashboards across all active deals and ES workstreams, anchored by a definitive ES Integration Master Plan as the authoritative single source of truth for ES leadership and the SVP, and including V2MOM progress tracking across active deals and integration workstreams.   • Org design, headcount mapping & synergy tracking: Drive the post close org design, headcount placement, reporting line mapping, and job leveling, in partnership with ES Business Partners and functional leaders. Monitor ES and headcount synergy realization against the financial targets set during diligence (e.g. duplicate role rationalization, retention pool allocation), giving the SVP a clear read on whether projected value is actually being captured.
  • Capacity & ES resourcing analytics: Track staffing bandwidth and workload across ES functional workstreams (e.g. HRIS migration teams, Benefits integration leads) to prevent burnout and single-point-of-failure risk during peak deal volume, and analyze ES M&A metrics (talent retention at Day 30/90/365, time-to-leveling completion, employee sentiment scores) to drive data-informed decision making.

About the Role:

As an Agentic Experience Specialist, you will be at the forefront of the evolution of user experience, specializing in crafting natural, effortless, and intuitive interactions between users and AI systems on the Salesforce platform. This role is pivotal in humanizing the power of AI by designing communication patterns that are clear, context-aware, and rooted in trust.


You will work directly with customers to design, implement, and optimize AI-powered solutions, ensuring every interaction feels like a natural extension of the customer relationship. Your goal is to design intelligent, brand-aligned behaviors for autonomous AI agents, enabling users to trust, understand, and confidently interact with AI-powered solutions that augment human productivity and creativity.
 

Your Impact:

  • User Understanding & Customer Strategy: Collaborate directly with customers (across industries) to understand their unique business needs and current experience to design AI-driven solutions that optimize workflows while maintaining high customer satisfaction. Conduct user research, analysis of existing chat and call transcripts, to understand user needs, behaviors, and pain points. Synthesize research findings into journey maps to identify opportunities for improvement within both employee and consumer experiences. 
  • Conversation & Interface Design: Lead the design of next-generation conversational AI interfaces for the Salesforce platform, ensuring they are intuitive, human-centered, and aligned with the brand's voice. You will define the AI agent's persona and design comprehensive dialogue flows and conversation maps. You will also focus on the design and implementation of voice interfaces, making them natural, empathetic, and responsive.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Create conversational prototypes using AI tools to visualize, test, and refine interaction flows early in the design process. You will design and execute conversation-specific test cases covering primary flows, edge cases, and error scenarios. You'll also advocate for the end user with continuous testing and learning cycles to validate hypotheses with data rather than assumptions. 
  • Collaboration & Implementation: Work closely with cross-functional teams—including FDEs, product management and engineering —to ensure the successful implementation of conversational agents on the Salesforce platform. You'll also develop and maintain design documentation to serve as a single source of truth for the solution’s experience vision and behavior.
  • Monitoring & Optimization: Analyze user feedback and live conversational data to identify pain points and opportunities for continuous improvement. You'll use data analytics to continuously refine the user experience, ensuring AI models evolve with customer demands. 
  • Build and scale resources for Builders (FDE/SEs) across Salesforce: Use in-field learnings to create, package, and enable other Builders on new and innovative delivery approaches to speed up delivery and increase customer experience  impact. This could include but is not limited to AI skills, Figma/Figjam templates, presentations, whitepapers, and other repeatable resources and tools.
     

Required Qualifications

  • Deep understanding of conversation design principles, NLU concepts (intents, utterances, entities), and human-to-human communication.
  • Strong user research and empathy skills, with a proven ability to design customer-centric AI solutions that focus on personalization and usability.
  • Experience with conversational prototyping tools (e.g., Claude Code, Figma, Okareo, Botsociety, Voiceflow) and familiarity with prompt engineering for Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Experience with Salesforce products, particularly Agentforce, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Salesforce Flow, and Salesforce Voice, with a strong understanding of AI-powered automation.
  • Excellent writing and dialogue writing abilities with a focus on clarity and brand alignment, paired with strong storytelling skills to communicate the impact of the agentic vision. 
  • Ability to interpret conversation data and analytics to measure the success of interfaces and drive improvements.
     

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant certifications and/or experience in conversation design, AI voice interfaces, or Salesforce Voice.
  • Experience engaging with C-level executives to define AI and UX strategies for large-scale projects.
  • Proven ability to facilitate experience-based design workshops with customers to gather insights and shape product offerings.

Salesforce Ventures (SFV) is the global venture capital arm of Salesforce and one of the most active enterprise investors in the world. Founded in 2009, the firm is a global, financially driven venture capital firm that has invested over $7B in more than 700 enterprise software companies, with 35 IPOs and 190+ M&A exits, and offices across the U.S., Europe, and Asia.

The firm invests patient capital: the flexibility of an evergreen funding model supports annual funds of $800M+. SFV invests at any stage, from seed to pre-IPO, with investments that range from $10M-$50M or more. Core investment themes include AI, Data & Infrastructure, Security, and Vertical & Horizontal Apps, along with New Frontiers (i.e. Energy, Space).

SFV wins competitive allocations on the strength of its team and technical expertise, portfolio, and unique platform advantages, which include access to Salesforce expertise, customer base, and Fortune 500 companies.

The Salesforce Ventures Finance team sits at the center of portfolio monitoring, investment operations, fund finance, executive communications, and internal reporting, supporting the fund’s full lifecycle from deal approval through exit. The team manages financial data and reporting across a portfolio of more than 400 companies, using an extensive portfolio monitoring process to surface trends and insights that inform portfolio decisions.

The Finance Manager will work closely with the investment, data science, and legal teams, with regular exposure to financial modeling, fast-moving deal activity, and senior leadership. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, comfortable with ambiguity, and able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams in a fast-paced environment. Specific responsibilities include:

  • Derive insights and benchmarks on financial performance metrics and KPIs to inform investment strategy, diligence, and follow-on decisions - and flag early warning signs or risk indicators

The Renewals Team is responsible for managing and forecasting the entire book of renewals business. They forecast and track renewals trends and highlight adoption issues for the company.

The Renewals team partners with sales, customer success manager and support to execute retention strategy. They are responsible for conducting account review, risk assessment and due diligence while developing a renewal strategy. Renewal team members take ownership and maintenance of all renewal opportunities (direct customers and indirect through resellers), forecasting, negotiation, generate upsell/cross sell opportunities, engaging internal resources and closing renewals prior to contract expiration.

As a Scale Renewals Manager you start to handle a large number of renewals. Volume of contracts managed each month tends to be around 50 ~ 100(depends on assigned territory) for Direct and Reseller’s customers in Japan, Korea and Taiwan. You own driving the renewal to completion. You partner with the account team and develop a renewals strategy for every customer. You build quotes, review contract terms, negotiate pricing, look for up-sell opportunities, and handle objections. It is also needed to plan how to improve the current operation process and manage some contractors or outsource partners who are doing renewal management for small size of contracts .

You will be measured on renewal rate, contract term length, and KSO (Key Strategic Objectives) driving specific sales goals of your renewals and ability to negotiate favorable terms.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Drive all managed renewals thoroughly in assigned territory by identify risk as early as possible as well as generating revenue growth opportunity via add-on, upsell, upgrade, price adjustment (working location is Japan Tokyo Office)
  • Achieve or exceed monthly renewal targets and provide senior management with an accurate forecast and risk analysis of all assigned accounts
  • Develop and execute win/win negotiation strategies for contract renewals that maximize contract value while protecting and enhancing the customer relationship
  • Build strong working relationships across Sales and Customer Success Group Leadership
  • Closely monitor at risk accounts. Work with Customer Success, Support, and Services leadership to resolve customer issues and help remove barriers for the team
  • Serve as point of escalation for critical customer issues; provide summary of the overall ‘health’ of the account and use of our services
  • Answer customer questions and successfully negotiate issues related to renewal contracts
  • Attend and lead monthly regional calls to discuss renewal forecast, top renewals, at risk accounts (if required)
  • Managing some contractors or outsource partners to deal with high transaction volume customers.
  • Help develop and educate renewal best practices across the team
  • Maximize account growth opportunities by playing an active role on the account team and helping to identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities upon contract renewal
  • Own, drive and manage the renewals process in collaboration with the account team
  • Work with internal resources (Competitive Intelligence, Pricing, Product Management, Customer Success, Account Executives, etc…) to develop comprehensive ‘win’ strategies for renewals
  • Identify customer requirements, uncover roadblocks, and demonstrate strong account management capabilities to drive renewal to on-time closure
  • Communicate risk clearly and take the lead in developing resolution strategies
  • Accurately maintain a rolling 180 day weekly forecast of renewals of your territory



You're Our Person If...

  • High-level fluency in Japanese language (speaking, reading, writing, listening)
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills (TOEIC 730+ )
  • 3 years or relative experience or sales/account and/or renewal management experience from a software or SI/solution Selling industry are preferable.
  • Vast knowledge or experience of Business Application (CRM/SFA/MA experience as user/sales is preferable)
  • Fundamental understanding of Salesforce product solutions
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Considerable interpersonal skills are mandatory, including the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with others
  • Strong negotiation skills that allow for value-based contract negotiations
  • Knowledge of restructuring contract term and condition relating legal, finance and billing
  • Excellent computer skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Google Apps)
  • Degree or Relevant Work Experience Preferred



Leadership Qualities

  • PASSION: Passionate about Customer Success
  • BEGINNERS MIND: Always learning, approaches each interaction with open mind, great listener and hands-on
  • LEADERSHIP: Self-aware and strategic thinker; proficient at building strong relationships
  • TEAM PLAYER: Proficient at collaboration and working with members of a team
  • URGENCY: Ability to move fast and drive business value and results
  • OHANA: Embodies Aloha culture: A team player that everyone enjoys working with and has a generous heart
  • TRUST: Trust the company’s core values
  • ADAPTABLE: Excels in high levels of uncertainty and change

The Customer Success Manager maintains awareness of the customer's key events, needs, potential risks, and value drivers.

As a trusted advisor, the CSM will build a track record in customer success through superb communication with partners and extensive knowledge of the Salesforce platform to translate their business needs to solutions. You will forge relationships with your customers and account teams, develop a deep technical understanding of their Salesforce implementation, share standard methodologies, and adoption of proactive services. These activities will enable you to proactively set the customer up for success through optimization of the platform, with special care during critically important peak events.

As a CSM, you will occasionally act as a point of contact for any major incidents, owning the customer’s expectations and communications through the resolution of such incidents. The CSM acts as the technical main interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across both internal and external collaborators, including partners and ISVs, as required to address the customer needs.

The ideal CSM has an extraordinary focus on the success of the customer, is an exceptional communicator, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, enjoys forming relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, and has the ability to learn new technologies quickly.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the orchestration of all Signature deliverables, experience, renewal, and expansion.
  • Cultivate and maintain stakeholder relationships with the customer’s IT and business executive leadership, sponsors, and decision-makers within customer organizations that have purchased Signature.
  • Help your customers achieve their business goals and outcomes on the Salesforce platform by:
  • Coordinating the completion of the Signature Success catalog of services as required for your customer
  • Providing timely, proactive Salesforce feature guidance based on the areas of interest for your customer
  • Acting as an advisor to your customers for the adoption of new features of Salesforce’s annual release schedules and identifying potential challenges and risks to your customer's implementation
  • Communicate the value of Signature Success. Be accountable for ensuring all collaborators understand this value so that customers continue to renew Signature Success.
  • Act as an advocate for customers during the triage and resolution of high-severity cases to assist with the timely resolution of these issues.
  • Proactive Support & Enhancement: Conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
  • Internal Relationship Building: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
  • The CSM may be required to occasionally be available for some after-hour or weekend coverage depending on the customer’s need.
  • Evolution of Roles: Anticipate and adapt to role changes per evolving Salesforce needs.

Minimum Skills:

  • Experienced professional with 8+ years of relevant industry expertise in Technical Customer Success, SaaS platform use or project leadership, Technology Consulting, Technology Solutions Development, Technical and/or Solutions Architecture.
  • Exceptional English communication and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to communicate and influence effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.

  • Optimize change management procedures, driving automation and continuous process improvements to reduce release friction while maintaining rigorous audit readiness.


Minimum Requirements

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience with change management lifecycle, program management, or technical operations within enterprise environments.
  • Risk & Compliance: Direct experience in security risk management, configuration management, or technical controls assessment.

Essential Requirements


  • Experience in a Solutions Engineer, pre-sales, consulting or technical implementation role.
  • Good working knowledge of Salesforce, or a similar CRM.

  • You enjoy being in front of customers and can explain technical topics in plain language.

  • You use AI tools every day, and know where they help and where they get things wrong.

  • You keep up with technology trends and are willing to learn. You do not need to know everything on day one.

  • You are organised, can manage several customers at once, and like working with colleagues in other teams.

descriptionHtml:

About Salesforce

The Experience

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.


The SWAT Engineer is a hands-on troubleshooter for our EMEA South FDEs, covering Iberia, Italy, and EGM Middle East.

FDE engagements are time-boxed, so when an FDE hits a platform bug, a configuration problem, a product gap, or unclear docs, the whole engagement stalls.

Customers also have nowhere to go when an FDE-built agent breaks after graduation. This role fixes both.

The engineer takes requests from a shared queue and diagnoses issues using Splunk logs and traces spanning Agentforce, RAG, Data Cloud, and messaging.

They reproduce each problem with customer-granted access and then find a workaround or fix. If they can’t, they escalate to Product and R&D through the right channel or a GUS investigation, and they file bugs and VOCs. Each fix also goes into a shared playbook so the next FDE doesn’t hit the same wall.

The SWAT FDEs can also help build the POCs, demos, etc.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
  • Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
  • Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
  • Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, and validate the output.
  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
  • Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
  • Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.

  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

title: Principal Product Designer, Mobile - Messaging
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

User Experience

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters

Millions of people spend their working day in Slack. Mobile is a fundamentally different problem from desktop: less screen, less time, less attention. Someone catching up between meetings or on their way somewhere can’t scan their whole workspace, and shouldn’t have to. Deciding what they see in those moments, and what can wait, takes real judgment. Getting it right is the difference between a product that feels indispensable and one that feels like another thing demanding attention.

We’re looking for an exceptional Principal Product Designer to own Slack’s mobile messaging experience and raise its craft bar, right as agents are becoming teammates in conversations. Almost every assumption about mobile messaging is back on the table, and you’d be the person shaping what replaces them.

Messaging is the heart of Slack: messages, threads, channels, notifications, sidebar, activity, and how agents show up across the product. Our mission is to make Slack a best-in-class messaging platform again, reducing noise, improving clarity, and helping every person feel in control while working with their teammates and agents.

You’ll own the end-to-end design of messaging experiences across mobile platforms, from early exploration through the finish of the shipped product. You’ll also be a mobile champion across the broader design org, bringing coherence to how Slack’s messaging experiences work across phones, tablets, and foldables.

Core Responsibilities & Scope

  • Clarity at speed. Making complex conversations easy to follow on a small screen: hierarchy, density, and what earns someone’s attention in a thirty-second session.
  • Proactive, not just responsive. Today Slack waits to be opened. The opportunity is a product that arrives already knowing what matters: a brief before your first meeting, the one thread worth reading between calls. Mobile is where this gets solved, because a phone carries more context than any surface we have, and we’ve barely used it.
  • The interruption economy. Notifications are the most contested surface in the product, and agents multiply the volume. Deciding who earns an interruption, and designing the gradients between silent, ambient, and urgent.
  • Agents in the conversation. How an agent appears in a channel, a thread, a DM. Whether it reads as a teammate, a tool, or something we don’t have a word for yet.
  • Staying in control. Steering, correcting, and undoing agent work through touch, on screens with little room to explain what’s happening.
  • Familiar on every screen. Ensuring Slack’s messaging constructs keep up with the expectations of best in class mobile messaging experiences that billions of people use every day. Knowing when its best to use universal conventions, and when something needs to be unique for Slack
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Research to frame problems, make the hard tradeoffs, and carry design intent all the way through launch.
  • Lead design for core mobile Messaging end to end, from the first exploration to the last detail of the shipped build.
  • Prototype as a way of thinking. Build interactive prototypes directly in code in whichever tool fits, to work out gestures, transitions, and motion to test ideas with real users.
  • Deliver the finish: typography, layout, iconography, motion, accessibility, and every device size. The details that separate a good interface from one people trust.
  • Define how agents participate in conversations on mobile, and set patterns durable enough for the rest of the product to adopt.
  • Raise the craft bar beyond your own projects through hands-on work, sharp critique, and reusable patterns that help the designers around you do better work.
  • Keep mobile coherent with the rest of Slack by contributing to shared interaction patterns and our design system, rather than working around them.



You’re our person if

  • 8+ years of product design experience, with a strong track record of shipping high-quality mobile work on iOS and Android.
  • An outstanding portfolio demonstrating exceptional mobile interaction and visual craft. We want to see the thinking behind the decisions and the quality of the final product.
  • Visual design depth: typography, composition, hierarchy, and an eye that catches what others walk past. You can turn a sound concept into an interface that feels refined and obvious.
  • Prototyping fluency. You build the prototype yourself, in whatever tool fits the problem, because you need to feel the behavior before you can judge it.
  • Deep fluency in native mobile platform conventions, gestures, and accessibility, with good judgment about when to follow a familiar pattern and when to evolve it.
  • Instinct for context and intelligence: using signals like time, place, and what’s coming next to make a product feel helpful rather than presumptuous.
  • Real comfort in undefined space. Agents on mobile has no playbook, and you treat that as the appealing part rather than the risky part.
  • Product judgment to simplify complex workflows without flattening what people actually need.
  • Evidence that you lift the people around you: clear feedback, generous mentorship, and genuine partnership with engineers.



Even Better if

  • A plus: experience with messaging, chat, or communication products, especially the everyday interactions that help people follow a conversation and reply with confidence.
  • A plus: prototyping in code, or building your own mobile apps.



At Slack we have a positive, diverse, and encouraging culture. We look for people who are curious, inventive, and working to be a little better every single day.

Join a team of 10 within Salesforce AI Labs, bringing computer-use AI into production with the autonomy of a small startup and the reach of Salesforce. We’re building Systems Integration Agent, announced at Dreamforce, which learns how to operate enterprise applications and turns complex workflows into reusable, code-backed automation. Customers are already running workflows in production; now we’re making that success repeatable across more systems and use cases.


Making computer use dependable raises hard engineering questions. How does an agent know it succeeded? When should it reason, and when should it follow a deterministic path? How should it recover when an application changes or ask for help before making a consequential mistake?


You’ll help answer those questions in production. Our team works directly with customers, building alongside them and turning discoveries into reusable product capabilities. Drive Agent Development & Architecture

Join our Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) Security team in a fast-paced, strategic organization scaling through acquisition. This role is critical to successfully integrating new business acquisitions securely and efficiently. You will act as the primary security partner for newly acquired companies, guiding them through our integration pipeline. Your core focus will be performing meticulous gap assessments and integration engineering to bring acquisitions to Salesforce's standards for security and inform integration priorities. The ideal candidate is an innovative self-starter who balances deep technical security expertise with a collaborative, empathetic approach to partner integration.

Core Responsibilities & Scope

  • Create comprehensive integration plans for security workstreams with risk-based integration priorities during the acquisition integration lifecycle.
  • Drive and close the security work required to bring acquired businesses under our organizational MSA, DPA, and SPARC frameworks.

The Senior Builder Experience

  • Technical Ownership: Partner with a Deployment Strategist to own customer outcomes end-to-end. You're the senior technical authority in the room, ensuring deliverables meet the  highest engineering  standards, whether it was generated by an AI tool by a colleague or written by you directly. 
  • AI-Supported  Engineering: Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes are embedded in your  daily workflow. The conventions and patterns you develop tend to propagate through the team because other Builders look to your work as reference.
  • Roadmap Influence: Your field experience routes directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps you hit and the edge cases you encounter in real life customer environments become the features they ship. Senior Forward Deployed Engineers are the most credible voice in agentic AIproduct evolution.
  • Continuous Innovation: You're expected to stay at the forefront — piloting emerging AI tools, experimenting with new models and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

What You'll Actually Be Building

  • Own end-to-end build and deployment of agentic AI solutions for Salesforce's most strategic customers — from architecture decisions through production handoff.
  • Design and ship agentic systems on the Agentforce platform: agent logic, tool calls, multi-agent orchestration, deterministic guardrails, and the integration patterns that hold up in enterprise environments. Your reference implementations become the basis for how other Builders approach similar problems.
  • Own the data lifecycle: model design, processing pipelines, and data readiness for AI applications across Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer-specific platforms.
  • Resolve the technical blockers that other engineers can't — data integration failures, model deployment issues, orchestration breakdowns, performance regressions. These problems are routed to you because of your track record of solving them.
  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes across engagements.
  • Develop proofs-of-concept and MVPs quickly, with the judgment to know which decisions can be deferred and which need to be right the first time.
  • Codify what you learn. The patterns, reusable assets, and internal frameworks that come out of your real customer work become the playbooks the rest of the org draws from.
  • Mentor other Engineers through code reviews, pair sessions, and shared work. Most of your influence on developing engineers happens inside the same codebases you're building in.
  • Provide technical depth on at-risk or strategically critical deployments when senior engineering judgment is needed.
  • Surface field insights directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps and edge cases you encounter in real customer environments are some of the most valuable inputs to the Agentforce roadmap.
  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist on your team to translate complex customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Senior Forward Deployed Engineer If…

  • You have 6+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with proven end-to-end ownership of scalable production systems in enterprise AI, cloud, or SaaS environments.
  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • You're an expert in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex, and conversant in the others.
  • You've integrated LLMs into production, used frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex, and applied prompt engineering and responsible AI practices in real customer contexts.
  • You have deep experience in data modeling, processing, and analytics, with demonstrable proficiency across platforms like Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, or Databricks.
  • You bring deep Salesforce platform expertise: Agentforce, Apex, LWC, Flows, and Salesforce APIs.
  • You have an entrepreneurial, get-things-done mindset focused on fast, impactful delivery — and the judgment to know when "fast" is the wrong call.
  • You've mentored technical talent and created reusable assets — frameworks, playbooks, internal tooling.
  • You communicate clearly and credibly with engineering peers, customer architects, and executive stakeholders.
  • You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.
  • You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, embedded with customer engineers.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I/II, Agentforce Specialist, System Architect)
  • Familiarity with DevOps/CI-CD practices, observability tooling, or data governance frameworks
  • Experience architecting multi-cloud, multi-system enterprise AI solutions for Global 500 customers
